# Refined prompt: KI-Angebotswerkstatt in `alloq-offer` — multiphase plan (Etappe 0 + 1)

> Load `alloq-implementation` first in **every** phase, then `appkit-mantine-reference` before any `mn.*` component you have not used in this task, `reflex-state-and-architecture` / `reflex-testing-state` for states, `ai:building-pydantic-ai-agents` for the AI layer. Follow the test-first workflow and the definition of done of `alloq-implementation`. One phase = one reviewable PR. Do not start a phase before the previous one is green.

## Task

Build the AI-supported offer workshop described in `spec/ki-angebotswerkstatt.md` (German, 785 lines; read §5–§14, §17, §18 before each phase) **inside the existing package `components/alloq-offer`**. For an existing offer, an `offer_editor` adds customer sources (pasted text, EML, TXT, DOCX, PDF, PPTX, audio), the app extracts them, an LLM proposes a **User Story Map with simple stories (no acceptance criteria)**, the user edits map, stories and scope, the app drafts the chapters of the bound Word template, the user edits chapters in the browser, rule checks plus an AI review produce findings, and the app exports an editable DOCX (draft or final) into the existing QUO template layout.

The plan covers spec Etappe 0 (template proof) and Etappe 1 (first end-to-end version) in detail. Etappe 2/3 are only listed under "Out of scope".

## Decisions already made (do not re-ask)

| Topic | Decision |
| --- | --- |
| Placement | Extend `alloq-offer` (import `alloq_offer`). New code lives in a sub-package `alloq_offer/workshop/`. Depends only on `alloq-commons` + appkit, never on `app` or other alloq packages. |
| UI stack | Reflex + `appkit_mantine` (not Next.js as the spec suggests). Rich text via `mn.rich_text_editor` (Tiptap wrapper in `appkit_mantine/tiptap.py`). |
| LLM | Azure OpenAI through **pydantic-ai** (`OpenAIChatModel` + `AzureProvider`) behind a narrow port. Tests use pydantic-ai `TestModel` / `FunctionModel` via `Agent.override`, never the network. |
| Access | Whole workshop (sources, transcripts, map, chapters, findings, exports) read **and** write only for role `offer_editor` (`OFFER_EDITOR_ROLE`, `@requires_offer_editor`). Offer list stays readable for all. No per-offer ownership in Etappe 1. |
| Storage | A `BlobStore` protocol; first implementation stores bytes in Postgres (`offer_blobs`, `LargeBinary`, deduplicated by SHA-256) so server and desktop share files. Azure Blob is a later adapter. |
| Template | `Templates/QUO-33441-N7R0Z4_Preisindikation MVP Referenzdatenbank Treystar .docx` (styles `berschrift1..3`, 8 tables, 2 content controls, no Jinja tags yet). |
| Plan depth | Etappe 0 + 1 detailed. |

## Context (found in the repo)

- **Offer package today** (`components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/`): `entities.py` (89 l., `OfferEntity` table `offers`, `IndustryEntity`, `OfferStateEnum`), `models.py`, `repository.py` (`offer_repo`), `services/offers.py` (pure logic), `states/offer_state.py` (**578 lines** — do not grow it; workshop states are separate), `components/offer_*.py`, `pages.py` (`create_offers_page`, route `/offers`), tests in `components/alloq-offer/tests/` (one file per layer). Offers already carry `person_days`, `risk_buffer_days`, `production_cost`, `recommended_price` — reuse them as bound commercial values.
- **Access**: `alloq_commons/access.py` (`requires_offer_editor`, `requires_role` UI gate), `alloq_commons/roles.py` (`OFFER_EDITOR_ROLE` id 3). Background handlers cannot use decorators → inline role check inside `async with self` and list them in `INLINE_ADMIN_CHECK`-style lists of `tests/test_handler_authorization.py` (every new handler must be classified there; `alloq_offer` is in `OFFER_PACKAGES`).
- **Guards**: `tests/test_handler_authorization.py`, `tests/test_component_boundaries.py`, `tests/test_migrations.py` (one test per migration), `.claude/skills/alloq-implementation/scripts/check_file_sizes.py` (≤ 1000 lines; aim ≤ 400 per state).
- **Migrations**: head is `a2b3c4d5e6f7` (`alembic/versions/2026_10_22_offer_project.py`). Hand-written, `op.batch_alter_table`, named FKs/indexes, real `downgrade()`. Each new revision goes first in `KNOWN_REVISIONS` in `app/desktop/schema.py`. `alembic/env.py` must import the new entity module. **Never run alembic against the local profile** (it uses a shared remote DB) — the user applies migrations.
- **Async patterns**: only `@rx.event(background=True)` exists today (`alloq_dashboard/states/dashboard_states.py:170`, `alloq_project/states/project_validation_state.py:62`). `appkit_commons/scheduler/pgqueuer.py` is a cron-style scheduler, not a job queue — do not use it for workshop jobs.
- **Dependencies**: no LLM, docx, pdf, pptx or upload code installed. Add with `uv add --package alloq-offer <lib>` (CLAUDE.md: always `uv add`). `appkit_commons/ai/openai_client_service.py` exists but `openai` is not installed; prefer pydantic-ai's own Azure provider.
- **UI building blocks**: `alloq_commons/components/{shell.py (app_page), toolbar.py (window_toolbar, segmented, icon_button, primary_button), list_view.py, modal_layout.py}`, colors only from `alloq_commons/theme.py`, page popovers use `theme.PAGE_POPOVER_Z_INDEX`. `mn.dropzone` exists (unused so far). Static CSS goes to `assets/css/aq-*.css`.
- **Memory traps to respect**: list logic in big states → `rx.State, mixin=True`, never substates; keep DB code in place when splitting; `str(component)` escapes umlauts → assert on constants; `mn.number_input` on_blur sends formatted text; `rx.LocalStorage` lost on login; German names sort in Python, not SQL.
- **Docs**: feature docs live in `docs/features/` (see `offers.md`, `story-map.md`); diagram style per memory `docs-diagram-style`.

## Target layout (inside `components/alloq-offer/src/alloq_offer/workshop/`)

```
entities.py / models.py          # split into entities/ and models/ packages once > ~400 lines
repositories/                    # BaseRepository[XEntity, AsyncSession] + module singletons
storage.py                       # BlobStore protocol + DbBlobStore
jobs/                            # job entity helpers, claim/lease/retry, runner, handlers registry
extraction/                      # one parser per kind: text, eml, docx, pdf, pptx, audio
ai/                              # pydantic-ai agents, output schemas, prompt files, settings
services/                        # pure logic: map ops, story validation, scope, checks, diff, snapshot
content/                         # canonical content tree schema + editor HTML <-> tree converter
export/                          # template package loader, docx renderer, manifest
templates/quo_v1/                # chapters.yaml, rules.yaml, layout.docx (prepared copy)
states/                          # one state per tab; mixins for list logic
components/                      # sources, map, briefing, chapters, checks, export panels
pages.py                         # create_offer_workshop_page(sidebar) -> /offers/[offer_id]/werkstatt
```

UI text German; code, comments, logs English; `logger.debug` default, no f-strings in logger calls, never log source content or prompts (spec §15).

---

## Phase 0 — Template proof and content contract (spec Etappe 0, §6, §10.3, §13)

Goal: prove the QUO template can be filled with editable content before any AI work.

1. Inventory the QUO DOCX with a small script under `scripts/` (headings, styles, tables, numbering, TOC field, content controls, header/footer). Write the result to `docs/features/offer-workshop-template.md` (chapter list, which parts are static, which become generated, style names to use).
2. Define the **template package** `templates/quo_v1/`:
   - `chapters.yaml`: stable chapter keys, title, level, required flag, guiding question, content rules, order. First functional chapter is `story_map` (projection, not free text), then the QUO chapters (management_summary, loesung, leistungsumfang, mitwirkung, rahmenbedingungen, projektabwicklung, laufzeit, verguetung, annahmen_risiken …) per inventory; static legal chapters (Rechtlicher Hinweis, Rechtliche Bestimmungen, Bindefrist, Unterschriften) stay fixed text.
   - `layout.docx`: a prepared copy of the QUO file with `docxtpl` placeholders / subdoc anchors per chapter; customer data removed.
   - `rules.yaml`: per-chapter required info and checks (used in Phase 6).
   - A Pydantic `TemplatePackage` model + loader with a `version` string; compatibility check (every chapter key has an anchor in `layout.docx`).
3. Define the **canonical content tree** (`content/schema.py`, Pydantic, discriminated union): `paragraph` (inline runs: text, bold, italic), `heading` (levels 3–4 only inside a chapter), `bullet_list`, `ordered_list`, `table` (header row + rows of plain inline runs), `bound_value` (reference to a structured field, e.g. `offer.recommended_price`). Every block has a stable `block_id`. Anything else is rejected with a German validation message.
4. Word renderer (`export/docx_renderer.py`) using `docxtpl` + `python-docx`: maps each block to template styles, renders the story map as per-activity tables plus a story catalogue (key, title, sentence, scope), resolves bound values, adds no external resources. Unsupported blocks raise a typed error (no silent loss).
5. Reference export test: render a fixture with long text, nested lists, a wide table, umlauts/special chars (`<>&„“€`), many activities; assert structurally with python-docx (chapter order, headings, table cells, styles, TOC field present). Write the file to `tmp_path` and keep one sample under `docs/` for manual Word check.

Deps: `uv add --package alloq-offer docxtpl python-docx`.
Done: tests green; user opens the sample DOCX in Word and confirms layout (gate before Phase 3).

## Phase 1 — Workspace foundation, storage and job runner (spec §8.6, §14.2, §15)

1. Entities + one migration `2026_10_xx_offer_workshop_base.py` (down_revision `a2b3c4d5e6f7`):
   - `offer_workspaces` (offer_id unique FK → offers CASCADE?, no: RESTRICT like offers are never deleted; template_key, template_version, vision, roles JSON, map_revision int, story_seq int, doc_state `Entwurf|In Prüfung|Final`, created_by).
   - `offer_blobs` (sha256 unique, size, mime, data LargeBinary).
   - `offer_jobs` (offer_id, kind, status `queued|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled`, idempotency_key unique, payload JSON, input_revisions JSON, attempts, max_attempts, run_after, lease_until, error_class, error_message (technical text only), result JSON, timestamps). Index on (status, run_after).
2. `BlobStore` protocol (`put(bytes, mime) -> blob_id`, `get(blob_id)`, `delete`) + `DbBlobStore`; size limit from config.
3. Job runner (`jobs/`): `enqueue(kind, offer_id, payload, idempotency_key)` returns existing job for the same key; `claim_next()` uses `SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` on Postgres (plain select on SQLite tests); lease + heartbeat; bounded retries with backoff for transient errors; results of expired/cancelled jobs are discarded; model/parser calls run **outside** DB transactions. Handlers register by `kind` (registry pattern).
4. Worker: an async loop started via `app.register_lifespan_task` in `app/app.py`, enabled by config `offer_workshop.worker_enabled` (YAML + `__` env override), bounded concurrency. Desktop and server may both run it safely thanks to SKIP LOCKED.
5. Config section in `configuration/config.yaml` for workshop (limits, worker, Azure OpenAI endpoint/deployments, secret refs `secret:azure_openai_api_key`), loaded via appkit config pattern (`appkit-commons` skill).
6. Page shell: `create_offer_workshop_page(sidebar)` route `/offers/[offer_id]/werkstatt`, gated with `requires_role(…, OFFER_EDITOR_ROLE.name)`; tabs `Story Map · Quellen · Briefing · Kapitel · Prüfung · Export`; entry from the offer inspector ("Werkstatt öffnen", offer_editor only). Opening creates the workspace lazily with the default template package. Empty map shows guiding questions, never invented content (spec §5.1, "Liegen noch keine Quellen vor").
7. Tests: repository, job claim/retry/lease/idempotency (SQLite), state open/create workspace, authorization classification, migration test, `KNOWN_REVISIONS`.

## Phase 2 — Sources and extraction (spec §5.2, §7)

1. Entities + migration: `offer_sources` (offer_id, kind `text|eml|txt|docx|pdf|pptx|audio`, title, filename, mime, blob_id, sha256, version, replaces_id, status `hochgeladen|in Verarbeitung|nutzbar|teilweise nutzbar|fehlgeschlagen|manuell nötig`, status_detail, included bool, revoked_at), `offer_source_blocks` (source_id, seq, anchor JSON {page|paragraph|table|slide|shape|note|start_ms/end_ms|message_id}, kind, speaker, text, gap flag + reason).
2. Upload via `mn.dropzone` / `rx.upload` (type and size whitelist, no macros executed, macro-enabled Office types rejected) and a "Text einfügen" modal. Identical sha256 on the same offer → no new version, no new job. Replacing a file creates a new version.
3. Parsers (`extraction/`, one module each, pure `bytes -> ExtractionResult`):
   - pasted text / TXT; EML via stdlib `email` (subject, date, sender, message-id, quoted chain and signature detection, attachments become their own sources).
   - DOCX via python-docx (paragraphs, tables; anchors by paragraph/table index).
   - PDF via `pypdf` (pages; pages without text layer → gap "OCR nötig", not silently skipped).
   - PPTX via `python-pptx` (slide no., text frames, tables, notes; picture shapes → gap "Bildinhalt nicht ausgewertet").
   - Audio (WAV/MP3/M4A) via a `Transcriber` port with an Azure OpenAI transcription implementation (diarized output with timestamps if the deployment supports it — verify API via Context7 before coding); files above the provider limit get status "manuell nötig" with hint to upload a transcript. Speaker labels are technical (`Sprecher 1`), never identities (§7.3).
4. Extraction runs as job kind `extract_source`; status visible per source with retry button; failed/partial sources stay visible; user can include/exclude sources for drafts.
5. Sources tab UI: list with status badges, gaps, block viewer with anchors (no technical IDs shown).
6. Tests: one parser test file per kind with small fixture files built in the test (python-docx/python-pptx generate fixtures; EML as string; PDF fixture minimal), job handler test with fake `Transcriber`, dedupe/versioning tests, A01/A02 scenarios.

Deps: `uv add --package alloq-offer pypdf python-pptx` (+ `pydantic-ai-slim[openai]` if the transcriber uses the openai client in this phase).

## Phase 3 — AI port, process recognition and initial story map (spec §8, §9)

1. `ai/` port: `OfferAi` protocol with methods `propose_map`, `propose_briefing`, `propose_chapter`, `review`, each returning validated Pydantic output; implementation with pydantic-ai agents on Azure OpenAI deployments from config; prompt texts in versioned files (`ai/prompts/*.md`, version string stored with every run). Source text is passed as clearly delimited **data**; system prompt states that instructions inside sources must be ignored (§15). Call budget and timeout per job.
2. Output schemas: `ProposedMap` (vision, roles, activities → tasks → stories {title, role, goal, benefit, origin `Kunde|Vorschlag`, source_refs [block ids], scope always `offen`}, slices, skeleton suggestions, open questions, conflicts) and `ProposedBriefing` (statements per §8.1 type: Kundenanforderung, Belegter Sachverhalt, Lösungsvorschlag, Annahme, Offener Punkt/Konflikt; with source refs).
3. Entities + migration: `offer_activities`, `offer_tasks`, `offer_stories` (key unique per offer from `story_seq`, e.g. `US-07`, title, role, goal, benefit, scope `offen|angeboten|option|ausgeschlossen`, origin `Kunde|Vorschlag|Nutzer`, slice_id, skeleton, priority, source_refs JSON, split_from_id, archived_at), `offer_slices`, `offer_statements` (type, text, status, source_refs, needs_recheck, confirmed_by/at), `offer_map_revisions` (offer_id, revision, immutable snapshot JSON, created_by, created_at), `offer_generation_runs` (job_id, kind, model, prompt_version, input revisions, status).
4. Pure services: `story_validation` (exactly one sentence "Als … möchte ich …, um …"; reject Given/When/Then, "Akzeptanzkriterien", bullet checklists — A20), `apply_proposed_map` (app assigns keys; AI never reuses or reinterprets existing keys; new AI stories never get scope `angeboten` — A25), `snapshot_map` (builds revision JSON).
5. Job kind `initial_draft`: extract-ready sources → propose map → save map revision → propose briefing. No manual gate between steps (§9.1), but no chapters yet.
6. Tests: agent tests with `FunctionModel` returning fixed JSON; validation rejects acceptance criteria; keys stable; A19, A20, A21 (no knowledge base), A22 (variants kept as open questions), A25, A26.

Deps: `uv add --package alloq-offer "pydantic-ai-slim[openai]"`.

## Phase 4 — Story map, story and briefing editors (spec §5.3, §5.4, §8.3–8.5, §10.1–10.2)

1. Map tab: horizontal activity columns, task rows, story cards below; slice rows ("Erste durchgängige Fassung", "Mögliche Erweiterung") and skeleton marker; scope badge per story (colors from `theme.py`). Edit actions via menus/buttons (no drag and drop in Etappe 1): add/rename/reorder activity and task, add/edit/split/merge/archive/move story, set scope, assign slice. Story drawer: title, Rolle/Ziel/Nutzen fields, live sentence preview, origin, source anchors, open questions.
2. Every map write uses optimistic concurrency: handler sends expected `map_revision`; mismatch → German conflict toast + reload, no overwrite (A08). Each saved change bumps `map_revision` and writes a snapshot; split keeps `split_from_id`; archived keys are never reused (A23).
3. Briefing tab: statements grouped by type, conflicts show both source anchors (A03), "Als fachliche Entscheidung bestätigen" is a separate explicit action (§8.7, A17).
4. Story/scope change marks dependent chapters `needs_review` (hook ready for Phase 5; A09, A27).
5. Map-level AI actions as jobs returning a **proposal** (compare + accept), e.g. "fehlende Prozessschritte vorschlagen", "Story aufteilen". Proposals bound to an older revision are shown as "veraltet" (A07).
6. Keep states ≤ ~400 lines: `MapState` + `MapEditMixin` + `StoryDrawerState`, list logic in mixins. Tests per handler incl. conflict and authorization.

## Phase 5 — Chapters, editor, revisions and proposals (spec §5.5, §9.4, §10.2–10.4)

1. Entities + migration: `offer_chapters` (offer_id, chapter_key, current_revision_id, protected, needs_review, review_reason), `offer_chapter_revisions` (chapter_id, number, content JSON = canonical tree, base_revision, map_revision, origin `manuell|KI übernommen`, author), `offer_proposals` (target chapter or map, job_id, content JSON, base revision, status `offen|übernommen|verworfen|veraltet`).
2. Converter `content/editor_io.py`: `mn.rich_text_editor` value ↔ canonical tree, restricted to the Phase 0 block set (check in `appkit-mantine-reference` whether the editor emits HTML or JSON; parse HTML with stdlib `html.parser`, drop nothing silently — unsupported markup → validation finding). Round-trip tests for every block type (A06). Editor toolbar limited to the supported marks.
3. Chapter tab layout per spec §10.1: chapter list (left), editor (center), context (right: linked stories, sources, assumptions, findings, revision info). `story_map` chapter is a read-only projection of the current map revision.
4. Autosave with expected base revision (debounced); visible save state; conflict → visible message, no overwrite (A08). Revision history with diff and restore.
5. Job kind `draft_chapters`: uses map revision + briefing + template guiding questions + profile (Software/AI/Agent/Data Science, §12.2) to propose chapters; closely related chapters may be drafted together. Results become proposals, never overwrite a manual or protected chapter (A07). "Vorschlag übernehmen" creates a new revision; it does not confirm business decisions (A17). content.text:
I made three layout concepts on one design canvas: [Angebotswerkstatt Prototypen](https://claude.ai/artifact/SqvwnLbKttsfEL7XwnTcYX).

They use the current macOS-blue Alloq look from `theme.py` (colors, system font, card shadows, radii). I did not use the Alloq design system, because it still has the old teal colors. All three show the same example from spec §16, the Kundenanfragen offer with stories ANF-01 to ANF-07. The mockups are static, and I haven't opened them in a browser to check them.

- **A · Arbeitsbereich mit Tabs:** this follows the plan most closely. The normal Alloq sidebar is on the left. The workspace has tabs: Story Map, Quellen, Briefing, Kapitel, Prüfung and Export.
  - The map is a full grid of activities, tasks and slice rows. Story cards show the scope, the walking skeleton marker and AI suggestions drawn with a dashed border.
  - A story inspector on the right has Rolle, Ziel and Nutzen fields with a preview of the full sentence, a scope switch and links to the sources.
  - A list of open questions sits below the map, and a status bar shows the save state, blockers and the export buttons.
- **B · Cockpit:** this is the layout drawn in spec §10.1.
  - A compact map band at the top stays visible and can be collapsed.
  - Below it are three panes: the chapter list with a status per chapter, the rich text editor and a context panel. The context panel shows the linked stories, check findings, the AI proposal and source locations.
  - The editor shows the case where the map changed: a banner says the chapter is out of date, the sentence that conflicts with the scope is highlighted, and the effort appears as an unconfirmed linked value.
- **C · Dokumentfluss:** the work happens on the offer document itself.
  - A progress row across the top lets you jump to any step: Quellen, Story Map, Briefing, Kapitel, Prüfung, Export.
  - The left side shows the document outline. In the middle is the page as it will look in Word, with the map as a table, an AI change shown inline to accept or reject, and an unsupported claim marked in the text.
  - A panel on the right shows findings, a briefing conflict with both sources, source statuses and export. Final export is locked while there is a blocker.

The canvas is private. Other people can only open the link after you share it from the page's Share menu.

content.text:
I added a new row called "Kombination A + C – Entwurf in einem Durchlauf" to the canvas: [Angebotswerkstatt Prototypen](https://claude.ai/artifact/SqvwnLbKttsfEL7XwnTcYX). It has two clickable boards. I haven't clicked through them in Play mode yet, so a broken button is possible.

**1 · Entwurf erzeugen und Story Map anpassen**
- **Start:** you choose which sources to use (EML, audio, PPTX, PDF). Gaps such as unanalysed images or a page that needs OCR are shown. There is one button, "Entwurf aus 3 Quellen erzeugen", and an option to start the draft automatically when new sources become usable.
- **One run, no stops in between:** a progress list shows the steps: analyse sources, find processes and roles, build the story map, write the briefing, propose a scope, draft all 9 chapters, run the checks, create the Word draft.
- **Result:** a summary card says the first draft is done, with buttons to download the Word draft and to view the chapters. Below it is a short list called "Braucht deine Entscheidung" with only what the AI must not decide alone:
  - confirm the proposed scope (one click marks the 5 skeleton stories as offered)
  - settle the Cloud versus On-Premises conflict
  - confirm effort and price, which is only needed for the final version
- **Optional editing of the map:**
  - Activities can be renamed, moved left or right, added, and removed if they have no stories.
  - Each activity has an editable task.
  - You can add and rename release slices ("Umsetzungsschnitte").
  - Every cell has "+ Story", and new stories get the next free ANF number.
  - Clicking a story opens a side panel for Rolle, Ziel and Nutzen, with the full sentence shown live. It also has the scope, a move to another activity or slice, split and archive.
  - "Fehlende Schritte vorschlagen" adds a dashed AI suggestion that you accept or reject. It only gets an ANF number when you accept it.
  - Any edit raises the revision number and shows "Kapitel neu vorschlagen". Chapters you edited by hand are not overwritten.
- In the Tweaks panel, the "startPhase" setting lets you start the board directly with the finished draft.

**2 · Kapitel im Dokument**

This board has A's frame and C's document view:
- The chapter outline is on the left and the offer page in Word layout is in the middle. The story map appears there as a table you can only change in the map editor, and the Management Summary text can be edited directly.
- The review's AI proposal to replace the unsupported promise ("garantiert um die Hälfte") can be accepted or rejected. If you accept it, the check finding disappears.
- The right side shows check findings, the stories and sources linked to the chapter, a switch to protect the chapter from AI changes, and export. The final version stays locked while findings are open.

The saved plan in `spec/plans/ki-angebotswerkstatt.md` doesn't match this yet. Its Phase 3 first draft stops after the map and the briefing, so it needs updating to the one-click full draft and this layout.

content.text:
I rebuilt the board "A + C · 2 Kapitel im Dokument: Kapiteltypen" on the [canvas](https://claude.ai/artifact/SqvwnLbKttsfEL7XwnTcYX). I haven't clicked through it in Play mode yet, so a broken button is possible.

**The story map from A is now chapter 1 of the document.** It uses the same cards as A: activities and tasks across the top, one row per release slice ("Umsetzungsschnitt"), story cards colored by scope, the S marker for the first end-to-end version, and AI suggestions drawn with a dashed border. In Word it becomes an editable table with colored cells, not an image. You change it only in the story map editor, and the chapter settings have a switch to hide the "Mögliche Erweiterung" row.

**Each chapter has a type.** The type shows as a badge on the chapter heading and as a short label in the outline:

| Type | In the document | Settings on the right |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Story Map** | Graphical map, at most once per document | Show or hide extensions, link to the map editor |
| **User Stories** | Catalogue from the map: key, title, scope label and one sentence per story, no acceptance criteria | Which scopes to include (offered, option, open, excluded), group by activity or by slice; the list updates right away |
| **Fließtext** | Free text you edit directly on the page | Protect the chapter from AI changes; AI actions such as redraft, shorten, more technical |
| **Tabelle** | Header row plus cells you edit directly | Columns; button to add a row |
| **Kalkulation** | Effort and price as linked values, marked "nicht bestätigt" until confirmed | Note that the final version is locked; link to the calculation |

You can add a chapter with "+ Kapitel" in the outline or at the end of the document. A menu lets you pick the type, and the new chapter goes in after the selected one. Every chapter can be renamed, moved up or down, and removed unless it is required. The example document has six chapters: Story Map, Management Summary, Angebotene User Stories, Angebotene Lösung, a Mitwirkungspflichten table and Vergütung. I also made the board taller on the canvas so the whole document fits.

The saved plan in `spec/plans/ki-angebotswerkstatt.md` doesn't include the chapter types yet. They affect the content model (Phase 0), the chapter entity and editor (Phase 5) and the Word export (Phase 7).

content.text:
I updated [spec/plans/ki-angebotswerkstatt.md](spec/plans/ki-angebotswerkstatt.md) to match the prototypes. It is not committed yet.

**New at the top**
- **Task:** now describes the one-click full draft and links to the prototype canvas.
- **Decisions table:** three new rows: first draft in one click from start to end, the story map as its own screen, and a document made of typed chapters.
- **New section "Deliberate deviations from the spec":**
  - The spec (§6.1, §6.3, §11.1, §13.1 and test case A24) puts the story map at the start of the Word document. The plan now says the map stays in the app, and Word gets the written stories through a `stories` chapter.
  - The first run also creates the scope proposal, the checks and the Word draft. A scope proposal still does not count as offered until you confirm it.

**Changes per phase**
- **Phase 0 (content model and Word export):**
  - `chapters.yaml` gets a `chapter_type` and defaults per type. There is no map chapter.
  - The content model has four types:
    - `prose`: text blocks.
    - `table`: columns and rows.
    - `stories`: only settings (which scopes, grouping); the stories themselves are filled in from the map when the document is rendered.
    - `calc`: values linked to the calculation.
  - The Word export has one renderer per chapter type and never draws the map graphic.
- **Phase 1:** the tabs are now "Entwurf & Story Map · Kapitel · Briefing · Export", with the start card from the prototype.
- **Phase 3:** `initial_draft` runs as one pipeline: extract, map, briefing, scope proposal, chapters, checks, Word draft. Each step is saved before the next starts, so a failed run continues from the last finished step. Phases 5, 6 and 7 add their steps to the same pipeline. Phase 3 also adds the setting to start the draft automatically when new sources are usable, and builds the list of decisions the user must make.
- **Phase 4:** describes the "Entwurf & Story Map" screen as in the prototype: summary card, decision list, the map grid with editing, the story inspector and the sources panel.
- **Phase 5:**
  - Chapters store their type, position and settings.
  - The "Kapitel" screen is described with its outline, page view, add-chapter menu by type and per-type settings.
  - The AI only writes `prose` and `table` content. The app fills `stories` and `calc` itself.
- **Phase 6:** the check that the map comes first is replaced by "a `stories` chapter contains every offered story and no acceptance criteria". Findings appear in the chapter view instead of a separate Prüfung tab.
- **Phase 7:** the first Word draft is created automatically by the pipeline. Test case A24 now checks the written stories instead of the map.
- **Phase 8 and success criteria:** add a test that one click turns usable sources into a Word draft with no further input. The final DOCX contains the written stories and no map graphic.

input.new_string:
### UI design (binding)

The UI **must follow the design "Kombination A + C – Entwurf in einem Durchlauf"** on the prototype canvas <https://claude.ai/artifact/SqvwnLbKttsfEL7XwnTcYX>. It has two clickable boards:

| Board | File on the canvas | Screen in Alloq |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A + C · 1 Entwurf erzeugen und Story Map anpassen | `project/Werkstatt.dc.html` | Tab "Entwurf & Story Map" (Phase 1 start card, Phase 3 progress and decisions, Phase 4 map editor) |
| A + C · 2 Kapitel im Dokument: Kapiteltypen | `project/Kapitel.dc.html` | Tab "Kapitel" (Phase 5 document view, Phase 6 findings, Phase 7 export panel) |

- Before building a screen, read its board (Artifact tool, action `read`, `url` above, `path` = the file in the table) and match its layout, texts, states and interactions. The boards are a layout and behavior reference, not code to copy: build with `mn.*` components, Alloq shell parts and `alloq_commons/theme.py` tokens.

"""Job handlers by kind."""

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field


class TransientJobError(RuntimeError):
    """The job may succeed on a later attempt (timeout, rate limit)."""


class UnknownJobKindError(LookupError):
    """No handler is registered for the job kind."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobContext:
    """What a handler gets to know about the job it runs."""

    job_id: int
    offer_id: int
    kind: str
    payload: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    input_revisions: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    attempt: int = 1


JobHandler = Callable[[JobContext], Awaitable[dict | None]]

_HANDLERS: dict[str, JobHandler] = {}


def register_handler(kind: str) -> Callable[[JobHandler], JobHandler]:
    """Register ``handler`` for ``kind``; re-registering replaces it."""

    def decorator(handler: JobHandler) -> JobHandler:
        _HANDLERS[kind] = handler
        return handler

    return decorator


def get_handler(kind: str) -> JobHandler:
    try:
        return _HANDLERS[kind]
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise UnknownJobKindError(kind) from exc


def registered_kinds() -> list[str]:
    return sorted(_HANDLERS)

import hashlib
from typing import Protocol

from sqlalchemy import delete, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import BlobEntity

class BlobTooLargeError(ValueError):
    """The file exceeds the configured size limit."""


class BlobNotFoundError(LookupError):
    """No blob with this id."""


class BlobStore(Protocol):
    """Stores file content and hands back a stable blob id."""

    async def put(self, data: bytes, mime: str) -> int: ...

    async def get(self, blob_id: int) -> bytes: ...

    async def delete(self, blob_id: int) -> None: ...


def sha256_hex(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


class DbBlobStore:
    """Blobs in ``offer_blobs``, stored once per SHA-256."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        max_bytes: int,
        session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
    ) -> None:
        self._max_bytes = max_bytes
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def put(self, data: bytes, mime: str) -> int:
        if len(data) > self._max_bytes:
            raise BlobTooLargeError(len(data))
        digest = sha256_hex(data)
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            existing = await session.scalar(
                select(BlobEntity.id).where(BlobEntity.sha256 == digest)
            )
            if existing is not None:
                return existing
            blob = BlobEntity(sha256=digest, size=len(data), mime=mime, data=data)
            try:
                async with session.begin_nested():
                    session.add(blob)
            except IntegrityError:
                # A concurrent upload of the same content won the race.
                found = await session.scalar(
                    select(BlobEntity.id).where(BlobEntity.sha256 == digest)
                )
                if found is None:
                    raise
                return found
            return blob.id

    async def get(self, blob_id: int) -> bytes:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            data = await session.scalar(
                select(BlobEntity.data).where(BlobEntity.id == blob_id)
            )
        if data is None:
            raise BlobNotFoundError(blob_id)
        return data

    async def delete(self, blob_id: int) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            await session.execute(delete(BlobEntity).where(BlobEntity.id == blob_id))

    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:

        self._maker = async_sessionmaker(self.engine, expire_on_commit=False)

        async with self._maker() as session:
            try:
                yield session
                await session.commit()
            except Exception:
                await session.rollback()
                raise

    async def dispose(self) -> None:
        await self.engine.dispose()

    return workspace

"""Audio recordings: a transcriber port and its Azure OpenAI adapter."""

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Protocol

import httpx

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import AzureOpenAiConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction.models import (
    KIND_SPEECH,
    ExtractedBlock,
    ExtractionResult,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_AUDIO_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024
AUDIO_TOO_LARGE = (
    "Die Aufnahme ist für die automatische Transkription zu groß. "
    "Bitte laden Sie ein Transkript als Text hoch."
)
NO_TRANSCRIBER = "Für Aufnahmen ist keine Transkription eingerichtet."
REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 600.0


class TranscriptionUnavailableError(RuntimeError):
    """The file cannot be transcribed here; the user has to upload a transcript."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TranscriptSegment:
    start_ms: int
    end_ms: int
    text: str
    speaker: str | None = None


class Transcriber(Protocol):
    async def transcribe(
        self, data: bytes, filename: str, mime: str
    ) -> list[TranscriptSegment]: ...


def to_result(segments: list[TranscriptSegment]) -> ExtractionResult:
    """Blocks with technical speaker labels (``Sprecher 1``), never identities."""
    labels: dict[str, str] = {}
    blocks: list[ExtractedBlock] = []
    for segment in segments:
        text = segment.text.strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        speaker = None
        if segment.speaker:
            speaker = labels.setdefault(segment.speaker, f"Sprecher {len(labels) + 1}")
        blocks.append(
            ExtractedBlock(
                KIND_SPEECH,
                text,
                {"start_ms": segment.start_ms, "end_ms": segment.end_ms},
                speaker,
            )
        )
    return ExtractionResult(blocks=blocks)


def _segments(payload: dict) -> list[TranscriptSegment]:
    return [
        TranscriptSegment(
            start_ms=round(float(item.get("start", 0)) * 1000),
            end_ms=round(float(item.get("end", 0)) * 1000),
            text=str(item.get("text", "")),
            speaker=item.get("speaker"),
        )
        for item in payload.get("segments", [])
    ]


class AzureTranscriber:
    """Transcription through an Azure OpenAI deployment.

    A ``diarize`` deployment returns speaker segments (``diarized_json``); any other
    deployment returns timed segments without speakers (``verbose_json``).
    """

    def __init__(self, config: AzureOpenAiConfig) -> None:
        self._config = config

    @property
    def configured(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._config.endpoint and self._config.transcription_deployment)

    async def transcribe(
        self, data: bytes, filename: str, mime: str
    ) -> list[TranscriptSegment]:
        if not self.configured:
            raise TranscriptionUnavailableError(NO_TRANSCRIBER)
        if len(data) > MAX_AUDIO_BYTES:
            raise TranscriptionUnavailableError(AUDIO_TOO_LARGE)
        deployment = self._config.transcription_deployment
        diarized = "diarize" in deployment
        form = {"response_format": "diarized_json" if diarized else "verbose_json"}
        if diarized:
            form["chunking_strategy"] = "auto"
        url = (
            f"{self._config.endpoint.rstrip('/')}/openai/deployments/{deployment}"
            "/audio/transcriptions"
        )
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as client:
            response = await client.post(
                url,
                params={"api-version": self._config.api_version},
                headers={"api-key": self._config.api_key.get_secret_value()},
                data=form,
                files={"file": (filename, data, mime)},
            )
        response.raise_for_status()
        logger.debug("Transcribed audio of %d bytes", len(data))
        return _segments(response.json())

import asyncio
import contextlib
import logging
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs import queue
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs.registry import (
    JobContext,
    TransientJobError,
    get_handler,
    registered_kinds,
)
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

Clock = Callable[[], datetime]


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class JobRunner:
    """Runs queued jobs; several runners (server and desktop) may share one queue."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: WorkshopConfig,
        session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
        clock: Clock = utc_now,
    ) -> None:
        self._config = config
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._clock = clock

    async def _claim(self) -> JobContext | None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            job = await queue.claim_next(
                session,
                now=self._clock(),
                lease_seconds=self._config.lease_seconds,
                kinds=registered_kinds(),
            )
            if job is None:
                return None
            return JobContext(
                job_id=job.id,
                offer_id=job.offer_id,
                kind=job.kind,
                payload=dict(job.payload),
                input_revisions=dict(job.input_revisions),
                attempt=job.attempts,
            )

import reflex as rx

from appkit_mantine.base import MANTINE_VERSION, MantineLayoutComponentBase

DROPZONE_LIBRARY = f"@mantine/dropzone@{MANTINE_VERSION}"
REACT_DROPZONE_LIBRARY = "react-dropzone@15.0.0"


class MantineDropzoneBase(MantineLayoutComponentBase):
    """Base class for Dropzone components."""

    library = DROPZONE_LIBRARY
    lib_dependencies: list[str] = [REACT_DROPZONE_LIBRARY]

    def _get_custom_code(self) -> str:
        return """import '@mantine/core/styles.css';

    """Mantine Dropzone — file drag-and-drop zone.

    https://mantine.dev/x/dropzone/
    """

    tag = "Dropzone"

    """Accepted MIME types or react-dropzone Accept object."""

    max_files: Var[int] = None

"""Add, replace and switch customer sources of an offer."""

import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import PurePath

from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import SourceEntity, SourceKind, SourceStatus
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs import queue
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import source_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import BlobStore, sha256_hex
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

EXTRACT_JOB = "extract_source"
DEFAULT_TEXT_TITLE = "Eingefügter Text"
EXTENSION_KINDS: dict[str, SourceKind] = {
    ".eml": SourceKind.EML,
    ".txt": SourceKind.TXT,
    ".docx": SourceKind.DOCX,
    ".pdf": SourceKind.PDF,
    ".pptx": SourceKind.PPTX,
    ".wav": SourceKind.AUDIO,
    ".mp3": SourceKind.AUDIO,
    ".m4a": SourceKind.AUDIO,
}
MACRO_EXTENSIONS = frozenset({".docm", ".dotm", ".pptm", ".potm", ".xlsm"})
ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS = tuple(EXTENSION_KINDS)


class SourceRejectedError(ValueError):
    """The file is not accepted as a source; the message is shown to users."""


def classify_filename(filename: str) -> SourceKind:
    extension = PurePath(filename).suffix.lower()
    if extension in MACRO_EXTENSIONS:
        raise SourceRejectedError(
            f"Dateien mit Makros werden nicht angenommen: {filename}"
        )
    try:
        return EXTENSION_KINDS[extension]
    except KeyError:
        raise SourceRejectedError(
            f"Dieser Dateityp wird nicht unterstützt: {filename}"
        ) from None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AddedSource:
    source: SourceEntity
    created: bool


async def add_source(
    store: BlobStore,
    *,
    offer_id: int,
    kind: SourceKind,
    title: str,
    filename: str,
    mime: str,
    data: bytes,
    user: str,
    now: datetime,
    max_attempts: int,
    session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
) -> AddedSource:
    """Store ``data`` as a source and queue its extraction.

    The same content twice adds nothing. A file with a known name becomes the next
    version of that source and the old version is switched off.
    """
    digest = sha256_hex(data)
    blob_id = await store.put(data, mime)
    async with session_factory() as session:
        existing = await source_repo.find_by_sha(session, offer_id, digest)
        if existing is not None:
            return AddedSource(existing, created=False)
        previous = (
            await source_repo.find_latest_by_filename(session, offer_id, filename)
            if filename
            else None
        )
        source = SourceEntity(
            offer_id=offer_id,
            kind=kind,
            title=title,
            filename=filename,
            mime=mime,
            blob_id=blob_id,
            sha256=digest,
            version=previous.version + 1 if previous else 1,
            replaces_id=previous.id if previous else None,
            created_by=user,
        )
        session.add(source)
        if previous is not None:
            previous.included = False
        await session.flush()
        await queue.enqueue(
            session,
            kind=EXTRACT_JOB,
            offer_id=offer_id,
            idempotency_key=f"{EXTRACT_JOB}:{source.id}",
            payload={"source_id": source.id},
            now=now,
            max_attempts=max_attempts,
        )
        logger.info("Added %s source %s to offer %s", kind, source.id, offer_id)
        return AddedSource(source, created=True)


async def set_included(
    session_factory: SessionFactory, offer_id: int, source_id: int, included: bool
) -> bool:
    """Switch a source on or off for drafts; False when it is not in this offer."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
        if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
            return False
        source.included = included
        return True


async def retry_source(
    session_factory: SessionFactory,
    offer_id: int,
    source_id: int,
    *,
    now: datetime,
    max_attempts: int,
) -> bool:
    """Queue the extraction of a failed or manual source again."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
        if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
            return False
        source.status = SourceStatus.UPLOADED
        source.status_detail = ""
        await queue.enqueue(
            session,
            kind=EXTRACT_JOB,
            offer_id=offer_id,
            idempotency_key=f"{EXTRACT_JOB}:{source.id}:{int(now.timestamp() * 1000)}",
            payload={"source_id": source.id},
            now=now,
            max_attempts=max_attempts,
        )
        return True

"""Job handler ``extract_source``: read a stored source into citable blocks."""

import asyncio
import logging
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime

import httpx

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import (
    SourceBlockEntity,
    SourceEntity,
    SourceKind,
    SourceStatus,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction import (
    ExtractionError,
    ExtractionResult,
    Transcriber,
    TranscriptionUnavailableError,
    parse_docx,
    parse_eml,
    parse_pdf,
    parse_pptx,
    parse_text,
    to_result,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction.audio import AzureTranscriber
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction.models import anchor_label
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs.registry import (
    JobContext,
    TransientJobError,
    register_handler,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import source_block_repo, source_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import (
    SourceRejectedError,
    add_source,
    classify_filename,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import BlobStore, DbBlobStore
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session
from appkit_commons.registry import service_registry

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

JOB_KIND = "extract_source"
TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED = "Die Transkription ist fehlgeschlagen. Bitte versuchen Sie es erneut."
NO_TEXT = "Es wurde kein Text gefunden. Bitte laden Sie den Inhalt als Text hoch."
RETRYABLE_STATUS = 429

_PARSERS: dict[SourceKind, Callable[[bytes], ExtractionResult]] = {
    SourceKind.TEXT: parse_text,
    SourceKind.TXT: parse_text,
    SourceKind.EML: parse_eml,
    SourceKind.DOCX: parse_docx,
    SourceKind.PDF: parse_pdf,
    SourceKind.PPTX: parse_pptx,
}


def _is_transient(error: Exception) -> bool:
    if isinstance(error, httpx.HTTPStatusError):
        code = error.response.status_code
        return code == RETRYABLE_STATUS or code >= 500
    return isinstance(error, httpx.TransportError)


class SourceExtractor:
    """Runs one extraction; parsing happens outside any database transaction."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        store: BlobStore,
        transcriber: Transcriber,
        session_factory: SessionFactory,
        max_attempts: int,
        clock: Callable[[], datetime] = lambda: datetime.now(UTC),
    ) -> None:
        self._store = store
        self._transcriber = transcriber
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._max_attempts = max_attempts
        self._clock = clock

    async def run(self, ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
        source_id = int(ctx.payload["source_id"])
        source = await self._begin(ctx.offer_id, source_id)
        if source is None:
            return {"status": "skipped"}
        kind, blob_id, filename, mime = (
            SourceKind(source.kind),
            source.blob_id,
            source.filename,
            source.mime,
        )
        if blob_id is None:
            await self._finish_failed(ctx.offer_id, source_id, SourceStatus.FAILED, NO_TEXT)
            return {"status": SourceStatus.FAILED}
        data = await self._store.get(blob_id)
        try:
            result = await self._parse(kind, data, filename, mime)
        except ExtractionError as exc:
            return await self._failed(ctx, SourceStatus.FAILED, str(exc))
        except TranscriptionUnavailableError as exc:
            return await self._failed(ctx, SourceStatus.MANUAL, str(exc))
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            if _is_transient(exc) and ctx.attempt < ctx.max_attempts:
                raise TransientJobError(TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED) from exc
            logger.warning("Transcription of source %s failed: %s", source_id, exc)
            return await self._failed(ctx, SourceStatus.FAILED, TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED)
        status, detail = await self._store_result(ctx.offer_id, source_id, result)
        notes = await self._add_attachments(ctx, result)
        if notes:
            await self._append_detail(ctx.offer_id, source_id, notes)
        return {"status": status, "detail": detail}

    async def _begin(self, offer_id: int, source_id: int) -> SourceEntity | None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
            if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
                return None
            source.status = SourceStatus.PROCESSING
            source.status_detail = ""
            session.expunge(source)
            return source

    async def _parse(
        self, kind: SourceKind, data: bytes, filename: str, mime: str
    ) -> ExtractionResult:
        if kind is SourceKind.AUDIO:
            segments = await self._transcriber.transcribe(data, filename, mime)
            return to_result(segments)
        return await asyncio.to_thread(_PARSERS[kind], data)

    async def _failed(
        self, ctx: JobContext, status: SourceStatus, detail: str
    ) -> dict:
        source_id = int(ctx.payload["source_id"])
        await self._finish_failed(ctx.offer_id, source_id, status, detail)
        return {"status": status, "detail": detail}

    async def _finish_failed(
        self, offer_id: int, source_id: int, status: SourceStatus, detail: str
    ) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
            if source is not None:
                source.status = status
                source.status_detail = detail

    async def _store_result(
        self, offer_id: int, source_id: int, result: ExtractionResult
    ) -> tuple[SourceStatus, str]:
        status, detail = _summarize(result)
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
            if source is None or source.revoked_at is not None:
                return status, detail
            await source_block_repo.replace(
                session,
                source_id,
                [
                    SourceBlockEntity(
                        source_id=source_id,
                        seq=seq,
                        kind=block.kind,
                        anchor=block.anchor,
                        speaker=block.speaker,
                        text=block.text,
                    )
                    for seq, block in enumerate(result.blocks, 1)
                ],
            )
            source.status = status
            source.status_detail = detail
        return status, detail

    async def _add_attachments(self, ctx: JobContext, result: ExtractionResult) -> str:
        notes: list[str] = []
        for attachment in result.attachments:
            try:
                kind = classify_filename(attachment.filename)
            except SourceRejectedError as exc:
                notes.append(str(exc))
                continue
            await add_source(
                self._store,
                offer_id=ctx.offer_id,
                kind=kind,
                title=attachment.filename,
                filename=attachment.filename,
                mime=attachment.mime,
                data=attachment.data,
                user="",
                now=self._clock(),
                max_attempts=self._max_attempts,
                session_factory=self._session_factory,
            )
        return "; ".join(notes)

    async def _append_detail(self, offer_id: int, source_id: int, note: str) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            source = await source_repo.find_in_offer(session, offer_id, source_id)
            if source is not None:
                source.status_detail = "; ".join(filter(None, [source.status_detail, note]))


def _summarize(result: ExtractionResult) -> tuple[SourceStatus, str]:
    gaps = [
        f"{label}: {block.text}" if (label := anchor_label(block.anchor)) else block.text
        for block in result.gaps
    ]
    detail = "; ".join(gaps)
    if not result.text_blocks:

def _guard[F: Callable[..., Any]](func: F, role: Role, level: str) -> F:
    """Wrap event handler ``func`` so only users holding ``role`` run it.

    Mirrors appkit's ``requires_admin``: unauthenticated callers are redirected
    to login, everyone else without the right gets a permission error.
    """

    async def _check(self: Any) -> tuple[bool, Any]:
        """``(allowed, event)``; ``event`` answers a denied call."""
        login_state = await self.get_state(LoginState)
        user = await login_state.authenticated_user
        if user is None:
            logger.debug("User not authenticated, redirecting to login.")
            return False, await login_state.redir()
        if not has_role(user, role):
            logger.warning(
                "User user_id=%s denied %s action '%s'",
                user.user_id,
                level,
                func.__name__,
            )
            return False, rx.toast.error(_NOT_AUTHORIZED_MSG, position="top-right")
        return True, None

    @wraps(func)
    async def async_gen_wrapper(self: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        ok, event = await _check(self)
        if not ok:
            yield event
            return
        async for item in func(self, *args, **kwargs):
            yield item

    @wraps(func)
    async def async_wrapper(self: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        ok, event = await _check(self)
        if not ok:
            return event
        return await func(self, *args, **kwargs)

    wrapper = async_gen_wrapper if inspect.isasyncgenfunction(func) else async_wrapper
    setattr(wrapper, ACCESS_LEVEL_ATTR, level)
    return wrapper  # type: ignore[return-value]


def requires_viewer[F: Callable[..., Any]](func: F) -> F:
    """Allow a read-only event for the employee role."""
    return _guard(func, EMPLOYEE_ROLE, "viewer")


def requires_editor[F: Callable[..., Any]](func: F) -> F:
    """Allow a reading or writing event for the project manager role."""
    return _guard(func, PROJECT_MANAGER_ROLE, "editor")

"""State of the sources panel: list, upload, pasted text and retry."""

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.access import requires_offer_editor

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import SourceEntity, SourceKind, SourceStatus
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import source_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services import sources as source_service
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import SourceRejectedError
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.workshop_state import WorkshopState
from alloq_offer.workshop.storage import BlobTooLargeError, DbBlobStore
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session
from appkit_commons.registry import service_registry
from appkit_user.authentication.states import LoginState

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

UPLOAD_ID = "source_upload"
KIND_LABELS: dict[str, str] = {
    SourceKind.TEXT: "Text",
    SourceKind.TXT: "Text",
    SourceKind.EML: "E-Mail",
    SourceKind.DOCX: "Dokument",
    SourceKind.PDF: "PDF",
    SourceKind.PPTX: "Folien",
    SourceKind.AUDIO: "Audio",
}
READABLE = (SourceStatus.USABLE, SourceStatus.PARTIAL)
WORKING = (SourceStatus.UPLOADED, SourceStatus.PROCESSING)
RETRYABLE = (SourceStatus.FAILED, SourceStatus.MANUAL)
LOAD_ERROR = "Die Quellen konnten nicht geladen werden."
ADD_ERROR = "Die Quelle konnte nicht hinzugefügt werden."
SAVE_ERROR = "Die Änderung konnte nicht gespeichert werden."
EMPTY_TEXT = "Bitte geben Sie einen Text ein."
TOO_LARGE = "Die Datei ist zu groß: "


def source_row(source: SourceEntity) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The values the sources list shows for one source."""
    kind = KIND_LABELS.get(source.kind, source.kind)
    summary = f"{kind} · {source.status}"
    if source.status_detail:
        summary += f" · {source.status_detail}"
    return {
        "id": source.id,
        "name": source.title,
        "summary": summary,
        "included": source.included,
        "usable": source.status in READABLE,
        "ok": source.status in (*READABLE, *WORKING),
        "working": source.status in WORKING,
        "retryable": source.status in RETRYABLE,
    }


class SourcesState(rx.State):
    """Customer sources of the open offer."""

    sources: rx.Field[list[dict[str, Any]]] = rx.field(default_factory=list)
    paste_open: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)

    @rx.var
    def included_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for row in self.sources if row["included"] and row["usable"])

    @rx.var
    def can_generate(self) -> bool:
        return self.included_count > 0

    @rx.var
    def generate_label(self) -> str:
        noun = "Quelle" if self.included_count == 1 else "Quellen"
        return f"Entwurf aus {self.included_count} {noun} erzeugen"

    @rx.var
    def has_working(self) -> bool:
        return any(row["working"] for row in self.sources)

    @rx.var
    def is_empty(self) -> bool:
        return not self.sources

    async def _offer_id(self) -> int:
        workshop = await self.get_state(WorkshopState)
        return workshop.offer_id

    async def _user_name(self) -> str:
        login = await self.get_state(LoginState)
        user = await login.authenticated_user
        return user.name if user else ""

    async def _reload(self, offer_id: int) -> None:
        async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
            rows = await source_repo.list_current(session, offer_id)
            self.sources = [source_row(row) for row in rows]

    @rx.event
    def open_paste(self) -> None:
        self.paste_open = True

    @rx.event
    def close_paste(self) -> None:
        self.paste_open = False

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def load_sources(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Load the sources; also called while a source is still being read."""
        offer_id = await self._offer_id()
        if not offer_id:
            return
        try:
            await self._reload(offer_id)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Loading sources of offer %s failed", offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(LOAD_ERROR, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def toggle_source(self, source_id: int, included: bool) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Take a source into or out of the next draft."""
        offer_id = await self._offer_id()
        try:
            await source_service.set_included(
                get_asyncdb_session, offer_id, source_id, included
            )
            await self._reload(offer_id)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Switching source %s failed", source_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(SAVE_ERROR, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def retry_source(self, source_id: int) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Read a failed source again."""
        offer_id = await self._offer_id()
        config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
        try:
            await source_service.retry_source(
                get_asyncdb_session,
                offer_id,
                source_id,
                now=datetime.now(UTC),
                max_attempts=config.max_attempts,
            )
            await self._reload(offer_id)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Retrying source %s failed", source_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(ADD_ERROR, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def handle_upload(self, files: list[rx.UploadFile]) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Add dropped files as sources; rejected files are named in a toast."""
        offer_id = await self._offer_id()
        if not offer_id:
            return
        config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
        store = DbBlobStore(config.max_blob_bytes)
        user = await self._user_name()
        for file in files:
            name = file.name or "Datei"
            try:
                kind = source_service.classify_filename(name)
                await source_service.add_source(
                    store,
                    offer_id=offer_id,
                    kind=kind,
                    title=name,
                    filename=name,
                    mime=file.content_type or "application/octet-stream",
                    data=await file.read(),
                    user=user,
                    now=datetime.now(UTC),
                    max_attempts=config.max_attempts,
                )
            except SourceRejectedError as exc:
                yield rx.toast.error(str(exc), position="top-right")
            except BlobTooLargeError:
                yield rx.toast.error(TOO_LARGE + name, position="top-right")
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("Adding an uploaded source to offer %s failed", offer_id)
                yield rx.toast.error(ADD_ERROR, position="top-right")
        await self._reload(offer_id)
        yield rx.clear_selected_files(UPLOAD_ID)

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def add_pasted_text(self, form: dict[str, Any]) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Add pasted text as a source."""
        text = str(form.get("text", "")).strip()
        if not text:
            yield rx.toast.error(EMPTY_TEXT, position="top-right")
            return
        offer_id = await self._offer_id()
        config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
        title = str(form.get("title", "")).strip() or source_service.DEFAULT_TEXT_TITLE
        try:
            await source_service.add_source(
                DbBlobStore(config.max_blob_bytes),
                offer_id=offer_id,
                kind=SourceKind.TEXT,
                title=title[:255],
                filename="",
                mime="text/plain",
                data=text.encode(),
                user=await self._user_name(),
                now=datetime.now(UTC),
                max_attempts=config.max_attempts,
            )
            await self._reload(offer_id)
            self.paste_open = False
        except BlobTooLargeError:
            yield rx.toast.error(TOO_LARGE + title, position="top-right")
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Adding pasted text to offer %s failed", offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(ADD_ERROR, position="top-right")

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import inspector, inspector_section

    MODAL_CLASS,
    modal_footer,
    modal_form_layout,
)

import appkit_mantine as mn
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.sources import ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS
from alloq_offer.workshop.states.sources_state import UPLOAD_ID, SourcesState

SOURCES_TITLE = "Quellen"
NO_SOURCES = "Noch keine Quellen. Fügen Sie Texte, E-Mails oder Dokumente hinzu."
SOURCES_HINT = (
    "Lücken wie nicht ausgewertete Bilder oder fehlende OCR bleiben sichtbar. "
    "Neue Quellen ändern einen bestehenden Entwurf nur als Vorschlag."
)
DROP_TEXT = "E-Mails, Mitschnitte, Konzepte oder Folien hier ablegen"
ADD_TEXT = "Text einfügen"
PASTE_TITLE = "Text als Quelle einfügen"
PASTE_SUBMIT = "Quelle hinzufügen"
RETRY_LABEL = "Erneut versuchen"
UPLOAD_ACCEPT = {
    "message/rfc822": [".eml"],
    "text/plain": [".txt"],
    "application/pdf": [".pdf"],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": [
        ".docx"
    ],
    "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation": [
        ".pptx"
    ],
    "audio/*": [".wav", ".mp3", ".m4a"],
}
STATUS_POLL_MS = 3000

assert set(ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS) == {  # noqa: S101 - keeps the picker and the parsers in step
    ext for exts in UPLOAD_ACCEPT.values() for ext in exts
}


def _drop_area() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.upload(
        mn.text(DROP_TEXT, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, ta="center"),
        id=UPLOAD_ID,
        accept=UPLOAD_ACCEPT,
        multiple=True,
        no_keyboard=False,
        on_drop=SourcesState.handle_upload(rx.upload_files(upload_id=UPLOAD_ID)),
        style={
            "border": f"1px dashed {theme.BORDER}",
            "borderRadius": "10px",
            "padding": "14px",
            "cursor": "pointer",
        },
    )


def _source_row(source: rx.Var) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        mn.checkbox(
            checked=source["included"],
            disabled=~source["usable"],
            on_change=lambda checked: SourcesState.toggle_source(source["id"], checked),
        ),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(source["name"], fw=600, fz="13px"),
            mn.text(
                source["summary"],
                fz="12px",
                c=rx.cond(source["ok"], theme.POSITIVE, theme.WARNING),
            ),
            gap=2,
            style={"minWidth": "0", "flex": "1"},
        ),
        rx.cond(
            source["retryable"],
            mn.button(
                RETRY_LABEL,
                variant="subtle",
                size="compact-xs",
                on_click=SourcesState.retry_source(source["id"]),
            ),
        ),
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="flex-start",
        p=10,
        style={"borderRadius": "8px", "background": theme.SURFACE_MUTED},
    )


def _paste_modal() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.stack(
                mn.text_input(
                    name="title",
                    label="Bezeichnung",
                    placeholder="z.B. Notizen aus dem Telefonat",
                    custom_attrs={"maxLength": 255},
                ),
                mn.textarea(
                    name="text",
                    label="Text",
                    required=True,
                    autosize=True,
                    min_rows=8,
                    max_rows=16,
                ),
                gap="md",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(PASTE_SUBMIT, SourcesState.close_paste),
            on_submit=SourcesState.add_pasted_text,
            reset_on_submit=True,
        ),
        title=PASTE_TITLE,
        opened=SourcesState.paste_open,
        on_close=SourcesState.close_paste,
        size="lg",
        centered=True,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


def sources_panel() -> rx.Component:
    return inspector(
        inspector_section(
            SOURCES_TITLE,
            mn.group(
                mn.button(
                    ADD_TEXT,
                    variant="subtle",
                    size="compact-sm",
                    on_click=SourcesState.open_paste,
                ),
                justify="flex-end",
            ),
            _drop_area(),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.is_empty,
                mn.text(NO_SOURCES, fz="13px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED),
                mn.stack(rx.foreach(SourcesState.sources, _source_row), gap=6),
            ),
            mn.text(SOURCES_HINT, fz="12px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, lh="1.5"),
            rx.cond(
                SourcesState.has_working,
                rx.moment(
                    interval=STATUS_POLL_MS,
                    on_change=SourcesState.load_sources,
                    display="none",
                ),
            ),
        ),
        _paste_modal(),
        label=SOURCES_TITLE,
    )

Phase 0 und 1 sind in zwei Commits gespeichert. Phase 2 (Quellen und Extraktion) ist umgesetzt und mit /simplify und /code-review geprüft. Alle 1741 Tests laufen, Lint und Typprüfung sind sauber. Phase 2 ist nur gestaged, nicht committet.

**Was Phase 2 kann**
- **Parser:** Text, E-Mail, Word, PDF und PowerPoint. PDF-Seiten ohne Text und Bilder in Folien erscheinen als sichtbare Lücken ("OCR nötig", "Bildinhalt nicht ausgewertet").
- **Audio:** Transkription über Azure OpenAI mit Sprecherlabels wie "Sprecher 1". Die Anbindung ist nur gegen einen simulierten Server getestet, nicht gegen ein echtes Azure-Deployment. Ohne konfiguriertes Deployment oder bei Dateien über 25 MB steht die Quelle auf "manuell nötig".
- **Quellen:** Die Tabellen `offer_sources` und `offer_source_blocks` kommen mit der Migration `c4d5e6f7a8b9`. Gleicher Inhalt erzeugt keine neue Quelle. Eine Datei mit bekanntem Namen wird die nächste Version, die alte wird abgeschaltet.
- **Job `extract_source`:** Er liest die Quelle in Blöcke und setzt den Status. Anhänge einer E-Mail werden eigene Quellen. Scheitert ein Job unerwartet, steht die Quelle auf "fehlgeschlagen" statt in der Verarbeitung.
- **Oberfläche im Entwurf-Tab:** Ablegefläche, "Text einfügen"-Dialog, Quellenliste mit Status, Häkchen zum Ein- und Ausschließen und "Erneut versuchen". Solange eine Quelle verarbeitet wird, aktualisiert sich die Liste alle 3 Sekunden. Für den Upload nutze ich `rx.upload`, weil der Mantine-Dropzone keine Dateiinhalte an Python weitergibt.

**Offen**
- Wenn der Worker mitten in der Extraktion abstürzt und die Versuche aufgebraucht sind, bleibt die Quelle auf "in Verarbeitung". Die Liste fragt dann weiter alle 3 Sekunden nach, und ein Wiederholen-Knopf fehlt.
- Der Extraktions-Job wird nur durch einen Import in `worker.py` registriert. Ein anderer Prozess mit eigenem Runner, etwa die Desktop-App, würde den Job nie abarbeiten.
- Kleinere Punkte aus dem Review: Uploads werden vor der Größenprüfung ganz gelesen, und derselbe Text unter zwei Titeln wird als Duplikat verworfen.
- Die Seite ist nicht im Browser geprüft, und die Migration ist nicht angewendet. Das tust du.
- Die Word-Beispieldatei `docs/features/offer-workshop-sample.docx` hast du noch nicht bestätigt, das ist die Bedingung vor Phase 3.
