"""One renderer per chapter type, selected through a registry."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Callable
from itertools import groupby

from docx.document import Document as DocxDocument
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.text.paragraph import Paragraph as DocxParagraph

from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import (
    BOUND_FIELDS,
    BoundValue,
    BulletList,
    CalcContent,
    Heading,
    Inline,
    OrderedList,
    Paragraph,
    ProseContent,
    StoriesContent,
    TableBlock,
    TableContent,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.models import (
    NO_GROUP_LABEL,
    SCOPE_LABELS,
    ChapterInput,
    RenderContext,
    RenderError,
    ResolvedValue,
    UnsupportedContentError,
)

TABLE_STYLE = "arvato-Tabelle blau"
BULLET_STYLE = "Aufzählung 1"
ORDERED_STYLE = "List Number"
NO_STORIES_TEXT = "Keine Stories im gewählten Umfang."
_ILLEGAL_XML = re.compile(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]")


class _Writer:
    """Appends content in front of the chapter anchor of a python-docx document."""

    def __init__(self, document: DocxDocument, anchor: DocxParagraph) -> None:
        self._doc = document
        self._anchor = anchor

    def _style(self, name: str) -> str:
        try:
            return self._doc.styles[name].name
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise RenderError(f"Formatvorlage fehlt in der Vorlage: {name}") from exc

    def _place(self, element: object) -> None:
        self._anchor._p.addprevious(element)  # noqa: SLF001

    def runs(self, paragraph: DocxParagraph, runs: Inline) -> None:
        for run in runs:
            target = paragraph.add_run(_ILLEGAL_XML.sub("", run.text))
            target.bold = run.bold or None
            target.italic = run.italic or None

    def paragraph(self, runs: Inline, style: str | None = None) -> DocxParagraph:
        paragraph = self._doc.add_paragraph(style=self._style(style) if style else None)
        self.runs(paragraph, runs)
        self._place(paragraph._p)  # noqa: SLF001
        return paragraph

    def heading(self, text: str, level: int) -> None:
        paragraph = self._doc.add_paragraph(
            _ILLEGAL_XML.sub("", text), style=self._style(f"Heading {level}")
        )
        self._place(paragraph._p)  # noqa: SLF001

    def table(self, header: list[Inline], rows: list[list[Inline]]) -> None:
        table = self._doc.add_table(rows=1 + len(rows), cols=max(len(header), 1))
        table.style = self._doc.styles[self._style(TABLE_STYLE)]
        for index, cell_runs in enumerate(header):
            self.runs(table.rows[0].cells[index].paragraphs[0], cell_runs)
        for row_index, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
            for index, cell_runs in enumerate(row):
                self.runs(table.rows[row_index].cells[index].paragraphs[0], cell_runs)
        tr_pr = table.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr()  # noqa: SLF001
        tr_pr.append(tr_pr.makeelement(qn("w:tblHeader"), {}))
        self._place(table._tbl)  # noqa: SLF001


Renderer = Callable[[_Writer, ChapterInput, RenderContext], None]


def _text(value: str) -> Inline:
    from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import Run

    return [Run(text=value)]


def _bold(value: str) -> Inline:
    from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import Run

    return [Run(text=value, bold=True)]


def _resolve(ctx: RenderContext, field: str) -> ResolvedValue:
    return ctx.values.get(field, ResolvedValue(text=None))


def _render_prose(writer: _Writer, chapter: ChapterInput, ctx: RenderContext) -> None:
    content = chapter.content
    if not isinstance(content, ProseContent):
        raise UnsupportedContentError(chapter.key)
    inner_min = min(chapter.level + 1, 4)
    for block in content.blocks:
        match block:
            case Paragraph():
                writer.paragraph(block.runs)
            case Heading():
                writer.heading(_plain(block.runs), max(block.level, inner_min))
            case BulletList():
                for item in block.items:
                    writer.paragraph(item, BULLET_STYLE)
            case OrderedList():
                for item in block.items:
                    writer.paragraph(item, ORDERED_STYLE)
            case TableBlock():
                writer.table(block.header, block.rows)
            case BoundValue():
                label = BOUND_FIELDS[block.field]
                writer.paragraph(
                    _text(f"{label}: {_resolve(ctx, block.field).display()}")
                )
            case _:
                raise UnsupportedContentError(type(block).__name__)


def _render_table(writer: _Writer, chapter: ChapterInput, ctx: RenderContext) -> None:
    content = chapter.content
    if not isinstance(content, TableContent):
        raise UnsupportedContentError(chapter.key)
    writer.table([_bold(c) for c in content.columns], content.rows)


def _render_stories(
    writer: _Writer, chapter: ChapterInput, ctx: RenderContext
) -> None:
    content = chapter.content
    if not isinstance(content, StoriesContent):
        raise UnsupportedContentError(chapter.key)
    stories = [s for s in ctx.stories if s.scope in content.scopes]
    if not stories:
        writer.paragraph(_text(NO_STORIES_TEXT))
        return
    heading_level = min(chapter.level + 1, 4)
    for group, items in groupby(stories, key=lambda s: s.group or NO_GROUP_LABEL):
        writer.heading(group, heading_level)
        for story in items:
            label = SCOPE_LABELS.get(story.scope, story.scope)
            head = _bold(f"{story.key} – {story.title}")
            head.extend(_text(f" ({label})"))
            writer.paragraph(head)
            writer.paragraph(_text(story.sentence))


def _render_calc(writer: _Writer, chapter: ChapterInput, ctx: RenderContext) -> None:
    content = chapter.content
    if not isinstance(content, CalcContent):
        raise UnsupportedContentError(chapter.key)
    if content.intro:
        writer.paragraph(content.intro)
    rows = [
        [_text(row.label), _text(_resolve(ctx, row.field).display())]
        for row in content.rows
    ]
    writer.table([_bold("Position"), _bold("Wert")], rows)


def _plain(runs: Inline) -> str:
    return "".join(run.text for run in runs)


RENDERERS: dict[str, Renderer] = {
    "prose": _render_prose,
    "table": _render_table,
    "stories": _render_stories,
    "calc": _render_calc,
}

"""Render the offer document: cover and legal tail from the template layout,
chapters from typed content. The story map graphic is never rendered."""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
from collections.abc import Sequence

from docx import Document
from docxtpl import DocxTemplate

from alloq_offer.workshop.content.schema import Run
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.chapter_renderers import RENDERERS, _Writer
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.models import (
    ChapterInput,
    RenderContext,
    UnsupportedContentError,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import (
    CHAPTER_ANCHOR,
    TemplatePackage,
)

DRAFT_MARKER = "ENTWURF – nicht zur Weitergabe an den Kunden"


def render_document(
    package: TemplatePackage,
    chapters: Sequence[ChapterInput],
    ctx: RenderContext,
) -> bytes:
    template = DocxTemplate(io.BytesIO(package.layout_bytes()))
    template.render(dict(ctx.cover))
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    template.save(buffer)
    buffer.seek(0)

    document = Document(buffer)
    anchor = next(p for p in document.paragraphs if p.text.strip() == CHAPTER_ANCHOR)
    writer = _Writer(document, anchor)
    if ctx.draft:
        writer.paragraph([Run(text=DRAFT_MARKER, bold=True)])
    for chapter in chapters:
        renderer = RENDERERS.get(chapter.content.chapter_type)
        if renderer is None:
            raise UnsupportedContentError(chapter.content.chapter_type)
        writer.heading(chapter.title, chapter.level)
        renderer(writer, chapter, ctx)
    anchor._p.getparent().remove(anchor._p)  # noqa: SLF001

    out = io.BytesIO()
    document.save(out)
    return out.getvalue()

import pytest
from docx import Document

SPECIAL = "Größe <b> & „Zitat“ 5 € \x0b"
SAMPLE_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "docs" / "features" / "offer-workshop-sample.docx"


def _runs(text: str, bold: bool = False) -> list[Run]:
    return [Run(text=text, bold=bold)]


def _chapters() -> list[ChapterInput]:
    wide = TableBlock(
        header=[_runs(f"Spalte {i}") for i in range(8)],
        rows=[[_runs(f"{r}-{c}") for c in range(8)] for r in range(3)],
    )
    prose = ProseContent(
        blocks=[
            Paragraph(runs=_runs("Langer Text " * 200) + _runs(SPECIAL, bold=True)),
            Heading(level=3, runs=_runs("Unterpunkt")),
            BulletList(items=[_runs("Punkt A"), _runs("Punkt B")]),
            OrderedList(items=[_runs("Schritt 1"), _runs("Schritt 2")]),
            wide,
            BoundValue(field="offer.recommended_price"),
        ]
    )
    return [

        ChapterInput(

        ),
        ChapterInput(

        ),

            1,
            CalcContent(
                intro=_runs("Kalkulation:"),
                rows=[
                    CalcRow(label="Preis", field="offer.recommended_price"),
                    CalcRow(label="Tage", field="offer.person_days"),
                    CalcRow(label="Kosten", field="offer.production_cost"),
                ],
            ),
        ),
    ]


def _context(draft: bool = True) -> RenderContext:
    stories = [
        ResolvedStory(
            key=f"US-{i:02d}",
            title=f"Story {i}",
            sentence=f"Als Rolle möchte ich Ziel {i}, um Nutzen zu haben.",
            scope="angeboten" if i % 5 else "option",
            group=f"Aktivität {i // 10 + 1}",
        )
        for i in range(1, 41)
    ]
    return RenderContext(
        cover={
            "project_title": "Projekt <Ä>",
            "customer_name": "Kunde GmbH",
            "customer_street": "Straße 1",
            "customer_city": "12345 Stadt",
            "customer_short": "Kunde",
            "offer_date": "1. Januar 2027",
            "quote_id": "QUO-1",
            "validity_date": "1. März 2027",
        },
        stories=stories,
        values={
            "offer.recommended_price": ResolvedValue("10.000 €", confirmed=True),

    )


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def rendered() -> bytes:
    return render_document(load_template(), _chapters(), _context())


def _doc(data: bytes) -> Document:
    return Document(io.BytesIO(data))


def test_cover_and_tail_are_filled(rendered: bytes) -> None:
    text = "\n".join(p.text for p in _doc(rendered).paragraphs)
    assert "Projekt <Ä>" in text
    assert "Kunde GmbH" in text
    assert "Leipzig, 1. Januar 2027" in text
    assert "bis einschließlich zum 1. März 2027" in text
    assert "{{" not in text
    assert "[[KAPITEL]]" not in text


def test_chapter_order_and_headings(rendered: bytes) -> None:
    doc = _doc(rendered)
    headings = [
        (p.style.name, p.text)
        for p in doc.paragraphs
        if p.style.name.startswith("Heading")
    ]
    titles = [t for _, t in headings]
    order = [
        "Management Summary",
        "Angebotene User Stories",
        "Mitwirkungspflichten",
        "Vergütung",
        "Rechtliche Bestimmungen",
    ]
    positions = [titles.index(t) for t in order]
    assert positions == sorted(positions)
    assert ("Heading 2", "Angebotene User Stories") in headings
    assert ("Heading 3", "Unterpunkt") in headings


def test_prose_blocks_and_special_characters(rendered: bytes) -> None:
    doc = _doc(rendered)
    text = "\n".join(p.text for p in doc.paragraphs)
    assert "Größe <b> & „Zitat“ 5 €" in text
    styles = {p.style.name for p in doc.paragraphs}
    assert {"Aufzählung 1", "List Number"} <= styles
    wide = next(t for t in doc.tables if t.rows[0].cells[0].text == "Spalte 0")
    assert len(wide.columns) == 8
    assert wide.style.name == "arvato-Tabelle blau"
    assert wide.rows[3].cells[7].text == "2-7"


def test_stories_chapter_written_stories_grouped(rendered: bytes) -> None:
    doc = _doc(rendered)
    texts = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]
    assert "US-01 – Story 1 (Angebotene)".replace("Angebotene", "Angeboten") in texts
    assert "Als Rolle möchte ich Ziel 1, um Nutzen zu haben." in texts
    assert not any(t.startswith("US-05 ") for t in texts)  # scope option filtered out
    assert "Aktivität 1" in texts and "Aktivität 5" in texts


def test_calc_marks_unconfirmed_and_missing(rendered: bytes) -> None:
    doc = _doc(rendered)
    calc = next(t for t in doc.tables if t.rows[0].cells[0].text == "Position")
    cells = {r.cells[0].text: r.cells[1].text for r in calc.rows[1:]}
    assert cells["Preis"] == "10.000 €"
    assert cells["Tage"] == f"12 {UNCONFIRMED_MARK}"
    assert cells["Kosten"] == MISSING_MARK


def test_draft_marker_toc_and_no_map(rendered: bytes) -> None:
    doc = _doc(rendered)
    assert any(p.text == DRAFT_MARKER for p in doc.paragraphs)
    assert any(i.text and "TOC" in i.text for i in doc.element.body.iter(qn("w:instrText")))
    assert not any("Story Map" in p.text for p in doc.paragraphs)
    final = render_document(load_template(), _chapters(), _context(draft=False))
    assert not any(p.text == DRAFT_MARKER for p in _doc(final).paragraphs)


def test_stories_without_match_are_visible() -> None:
    chapters = [ChapterInput("s", "Stories", 2, StoriesContent(scopes=["offen"]))]
    ctx = RenderContext(cover=_context().cover, stories=[])
    doc = _doc(render_document(load_template(), chapters, ctx))
    assert any(p.text == "Keine Stories im gewählten Umfang." for p in doc.paragraphs)


def test_unsupported_content_raises() -> None:
    bad = ChapterInput("x", "X", 1, ProseContent.model_construct(chapter_type="map"))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    with pytest.raises((UnsupportedContentError, RenderError)):
        render_document(load_template(), [bad], _context())


def test_write_sample(rendered: bytes, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    target = tmp_path / "sample.docx"
    target.write_bytes(rendered)
    assert _doc(target.read_bytes()).paragraphs
    if SAMPLE_PATH.parent.exists():
        SAMPLE_PATH.write_bytes(rendered)

# Offer workshop template (QUO)

The workshop fills the customer template `Templates/QUO-33441-N7R0Z4_Preisindikation MVP Referenzdatenbank Treystar .docx`.
`scripts/inventory_docx.py` prints its structure; `scripts/build_quo_layout.py` turns it into the package layout.

## What is fixed and what is generated

| Part | Source in the QUO file | In the package |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cover (title, customer, date, quote id) | paragraphs 0 to 25 | `layout.docx` with `{{ project_title }}`, `{{ customer_name }}`, `{{ customer_street }}`, `{{ customer_city }}`, `{{ customer_short }}`, `{{ offer_date }}`, `{{ quote_id }}` |
| Legal notice, supplier address | cover | fixed text |
| Table of contents | missing in the QUO file | TOC field `1-3`, updated when Word opens the file |
| Chapters Management Summary to Consumption | Heading 1 to 3 | removed from the layout, rendered from typed chapters at the anchor `[[KAPITEL]]` |
| Rechtliche Bestimmungen, Bindefrist (`{{ validity_date }}`), Sonstiges, Anlagen, Unterschriften | tail | fixed text; signature placeholders (`$$_PRT_..._$$`) stay untouched |

Customer data is removed from the layout. There is no story map chapter: the document shows written stories only.

## Chapters (`chapters.yaml`)

| Key | Level | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `management_summary` | 1 | prose | yes |
| `leistungen` | 1 | prose | no |
| `user_stories` | 2 | stories (angeboten + option, grouped by activity) | yes |
| `loesung` | 2 | prose | yes |
| `leistungsumfang` | 2 | prose | yes |
| `mitwirkung` | 2 | table (Mitwirkung, Verantwortlich, Zeitpunkt) | yes |
| `rahmenbedingungen` | 2 | prose | no |
| `projektabwicklung` | 1 | prose | no |
| `laufzeit` | 1 | prose | yes |
| `verguetung` | 1 | calc (person days, risk buffer, production cost, recommended price) | yes |
| `annahmen_risiken` | 1 | prose | no |

The consumption chapter of the QUO file is not part of Etappe 1.

## Word styles used by the renderer

| Content | Style |
| --- | --- |
| Chapter titles | `Heading 1` and `Heading 2` (style ids `berschrift1`, `berschrift2`) |
| Headings inside a chapter | `Heading 3`, `Heading 4`, never above the chapter level |
| Text | `Normal` |
| Bullet list | `Aufzählung 1` |
| Ordered list | `List Number` |
| Tables | table style `arvato-Tabelle blau`, header row repeats |

## Rendering rules

- Content is rendered by one renderer per chapter type; unknown content raises a typed error and is never dropped.
- `stories` chapters list the stories of the bound map revision: a heading per group, then key, title and scope, then the one sentence "Als … möchte ich …, um …".
- `calc` values are shown only when confirmed; an unconfirmed value carries `[nicht bestätigt]`, a missing one `[Wert fehlt]`.
- A draft export starts with the marker "ENTWURF – nicht zur Weitergabe an den Kunden".
- `docs/features/offer-workshop-sample.docx` is a reference export for the manual check in Word.

`/simplify → 4 cleanup agents in parallel → apply the fixes`

You are improving the quality of the changed code, not hunting for bugs. Review
it for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude issues, then fix what you
find. Do not look for correctness bugs — that is what `/code-review` is for.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Review (4 cleanup agents in parallel)

Launch **4 independent review agents** via the Agent tool, all in a
single message so they run concurrently. Pass each agent the diff and one of
the four angles below. Each returns its findings with `file`, `line`, a
one-line `summary`, and the concrete cost (what is duplicated, wasted, or
harder to maintain).

### Reuse

Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change fixes the root cause at the right depth rather than
patching a symptom with a fragile bandaid. Special cases layered on shared
infrastructure are a sign the fix isn't deep enough — prefer the simpler, more
general change to the underlying mechanism over adding special cases, and name
that change.

## Phase 2 — Apply the fixes

Wait for all four agents to complete, dedup findings that point at the same
line or mechanism, and fix each remaining one directly. Skip any finding whose
fix would change intended behavior, require changes well outside the reviewed
diff, or that you judge to be a false positive — note the skip rather than
arguing with it. Finish with a brief summary of what was fixed and what was
skipped (or confirm the code was already clean).

    def model_class(self) -> type[OfferEntity]:

    async def find_all_ordered(self, session: AsyncSession) -> list[OfferEntity]:
        """All offers, most recently updated first."""
        statement = select(OfferEntity).order_by(
            OfferEntity.updated.desc(), OfferEntity.id.desc()
        )

                ProjectEntity.id.in_(ids)
            )
        )

    """Gregorian Easter Sunday (anonymous Gregorian algorithm)."""
    a = year % 19
    b, c = divmod(year, 100)

"""File storage behind a port; the first adapter keeps bytes in Postgres."""

import hashlib
from typing import Protocol

from sqlalchemy import delete, select

from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import BlobEntity
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session


class BlobTooLargeError(ValueError):
    """The file exceeds the configured size limit."""


class BlobNotFoundError(LookupError):
    """No blob with this id."""


class BlobStore(Protocol):
    """Stores file content and hands back a stable blob id."""

    async def put(self, data: bytes, mime: str) -> int: ...

    async def get(self, blob_id: int) -> bytes: ...

    async def delete(self, blob_id: int) -> None: ...


def sha256_hex(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


class DbBlobStore:
    """Blobs in ``offer_blobs``, stored once per SHA-256."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        max_bytes: int,
        session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
    ) -> None:
        self._max_bytes = max_bytes
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def put(self, data: bytes, mime: str) -> int:
        if len(data) > self._max_bytes:
            raise BlobTooLargeError(len(data))
        digest = sha256_hex(data)
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            existing = await session.scalar(
                select(BlobEntity.id).where(BlobEntity.sha256 == digest)
            )
            if existing is not None:
                return existing
            blob = BlobEntity(sha256=digest, size=len(data), mime=mime, data=data)
            session.add(blob)
            await session.flush()
            return blob.id

    async def get(self, blob_id: int) -> bytes:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            data = await session.scalar(
                select(BlobEntity.data).where(BlobEntity.id == blob_id)
            )
        if data is None:
            raise BlobNotFoundError(blob_id)
        return data

    async def delete(self, blob_id: int) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            await session.execute(delete(BlobEntity).where(BlobEntity.id == blob_id))

"""Job handlers by kind."""

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

JobResult = dict | None


class TransientJobError(RuntimeError):
    """The job may succeed on a later attempt (timeout, rate limit)."""


class UnknownJobKindError(LookupError):
    """No handler is registered for the job kind."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobContext:
    """What a handler gets to know about the job it runs."""

    job_id: int
    offer_id: int
    kind: str
    payload: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    input_revisions: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    attempt: int = 1


JobHandler = Callable[[JobContext], Awaitable[JobResult]]

_HANDLERS: dict[str, JobHandler] = {}


def register_handler(kind: str) -> Callable[[JobHandler], JobHandler]:
    """Register ``handler`` for ``kind``; re-registering replaces it."""

    def decorator(handler: JobHandler) -> JobHandler:
        _HANDLERS[kind] = handler
        return handler

    return decorator


def get_handler(kind: str) -> JobHandler:
    try:
        return _HANDLERS[kind]
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise UnknownJobKindError(kind) from exc


def registered_kinds() -> list[str]:
    return sorted(_HANDLERS)

"""Persistent job queue: enqueue, claim with lease, finish, retry."""

import logging
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import and_, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import JobEntity, JobStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS = 300
ERROR_MESSAGE_LIMIT = 2000


def backoff_seconds(attempts: int) -> int:
    """Delay before retry number ``attempts`` (5 s, 10 s, 20 s, ... capped)."""
    return min(5 * 2 ** max(attempts - 1, 0), MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS)


async def enqueue(
    session: AsyncSession,
    *,
    kind: str,
    offer_id: int,
    idempotency_key: str,
    now: datetime,
    payload: dict | None = None,
    input_revisions: dict | None = None,
    max_attempts: int = 3,
) -> JobEntity:
    """Create a job, or return the existing one with the same idempotency key."""
    existing = await _by_key(session, idempotency_key)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    job = JobEntity(
        offer_id=offer_id,
        kind=kind,
        status=JobStatus.QUEUED,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        payload=payload or {},
        input_revisions=input_revisions or {},
        attempts=0,
        max_attempts=max_attempts,
        run_after=now,
    )
    try:
        async with session.begin_nested():
            session.add(job)
    except IntegrityError:
        # A concurrent enqueue with the same key won the race.
        found = await _by_key(session, idempotency_key)
        if found is None:
            raise
        return found
    return job


async def _by_key(session: AsyncSession, key: str) -> JobEntity | None:
    return await session.scalar(
        select(JobEntity).where(JobEntity.idempotency_key == key)
    )


async def claim_next(
    session: AsyncSession,
    *,
    now: datetime,
    lease_seconds: int,
    kinds: list[str] | None = None,
) -> JobEntity | None:
    """Lease the next runnable job.

    Runnable are queued jobs that are due and running jobs whose lease expired.
    A job that expired with no attempts left is failed instead of re-run.
    """
    while True:
        statement = (
            select(JobEntity)
            .where(
                or_(
                    and_(
                        JobEntity.status == JobStatus.QUEUED,
                        JobEntity.run_after <= now,
                    ),
                    and_(
                        JobEntity.status == JobStatus.RUNNING,
                        JobEntity.lease_until < now,
                    ),
                )
            )
            .order_by(JobEntity.run_after, JobEntity.id)
            .limit(1)
        )
        if kinds:
            statement = statement.where(JobEntity.kind.in_(kinds))
        if _is_postgres(session):
            statement = statement.with_for_update(skip_locked=True)
        job = await session.scalar(statement)
        if job is None:
            return None
        if job.attempts >= job.max_attempts:
            job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_class = job.error_class or "LeaseExpired"
            job.lease_until = None
            await session.flush()
            logger.warning("Job %s failed after %s attempts", job.id, job.attempts)
            continue
        job.status = JobStatus.RUNNING
        job.attempts += 1
        job.lease_until = now + timedelta(seconds=lease_seconds)
        await session.flush()
        return job


async def heartbeat(
    session: AsyncSession,
    job_id: int,
    attempt: int,
    *,
    now: datetime,
    lease_seconds: int,
) -> bool:
    """Extend the lease; False when this attempt no longer owns the job."""
    job = await _owned(session, job_id, attempt)
    if job is None:
        return False
    job.lease_until = now + timedelta(seconds=lease_seconds)
    return True


async def complete(
    session: AsyncSession, job_id: int, attempt: int, result: dict | None
) -> bool:
    """Mark the attempt done; False (result discarded) when it lost the job."""
    job = await _owned(session, job_id, attempt)
    if job is None:
        return False
    job.status = JobStatus.SUCCEEDED
    job.result = result
    job.lease_until = None
    return True


async def fail(
    session: AsyncSession,
    job_id: int,
    attempt: int,
    *,
    error_class: str,
    message: str,
    retry: bool,
    now: datetime,
) -> bool:
    """Record a failure; requeue with backoff when ``retry`` and attempts remain."""
    job = await _owned(session, job_id, attempt)
    if job is None:
        return False
    job.error_class = error_class
    job.error_message = message[:ERROR_MESSAGE_LIMIT]
    job.lease_until = None
    if retry and job.attempts < job.max_attempts:
        job.status = JobStatus.QUEUED
        job.run_after = now + timedelta(seconds=backoff_seconds(job.attempts))
    else:
        job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
    return True


async def cancel(session: AsyncSession, job_id: int) -> bool:
    """Cancel a job that has not finished; its result will be discarded."""
    job = await session.get(JobEntity, job_id)
    if job is None or job.status in (
        JobStatus.SUCCEEDED,
        JobStatus.FAILED,
        JobStatus.CANCELLED,
    ):
        return False
    job.status = JobStatus.CANCELLED
    job.lease_until = None
    return True


async def _owned(session: AsyncSession, job_id: int, attempt: int) -> JobEntity | None:
    job = await session.get(JobEntity, job_id)
    if job is None or job.status != JobStatus.RUNNING or job.attempts != attempt:
        return None
    return job


def _is_postgres(session: AsyncSession) -> bool:
    bind = session.get_bind()
    return bind.dialect.name == "postgresql"

"""Worker loop: claim a job, run its handler outside any transaction, record the result."""

import asyncio
import contextlib
import logging
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs import queue
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs.registry import (
    JobContext,
    TransientJobError,
    UnknownJobKindError,
    get_handler,
)
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

Clock = Callable[[], datetime]


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class JobRunner:
    """Runs queued jobs; several runners (server and desktop) may share one queue."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: WorkshopConfig,
        session_factory: SessionFactory = get_asyncdb_session,
        clock: Clock = utc_now,
    ) -> None:
        self._config = config
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._clock = clock

    async def run_once(self) -> bool:
        """Run one due job; False when the queue had none."""
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            job = await queue.claim_next(
                session,
                now=self._clock(),
                lease_seconds=self._config.lease_seconds,
            )
            if job is None:
                return False
            context = JobContext(
                job_id=job.id,
                offer_id=job.offer_id,
                kind=job.kind,
                payload=dict(job.payload),
                input_revisions=dict(job.input_revisions),
                attempt=job.attempts,
            )
        await self._execute(context)
        return True

    async def run_forever(self) -> None:
        """Poll the queue with bounded concurrency until cancelled."""
        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(self._config.worker_concurrency)
        running: set[asyncio.Task[None]] = set()
        try:
            while True:
                await semaphore.acquire()
                try:
                    found = await self.run_once_detached(running, semaphore)
                except Exception:
                    semaphore.release()
                    logger.exception("Job polling failed")
                    found = False
                if not found:
                    await asyncio.sleep(self._config.poll_interval_seconds)
        finally:
            for task in running:
                task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*running, return_exceptions=True)

    async def run_once_detached(
        self, running: set[asyncio.Task[None]], semaphore: asyncio.Semaphore
    ) -> bool:
        """Claim a job and run it in a background task that frees the semaphore."""
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            job = await queue.claim_next(
                session,
                now=self._clock(),
                lease_seconds=self._config.lease_seconds,
            )
            if job is None:
                semaphore.release()
                return False
            context = JobContext(
                job_id=job.id,
                offer_id=job.offer_id,
                kind=job.kind,
                payload=dict(job.payload),
                input_revisions=dict(job.input_revisions),
                attempt=job.attempts,
            )
        task = asyncio.create_task(self._execute(context))
        running.add(task)

        def _done(finished: asyncio.Task[None]) -> None:
            running.discard(finished)
            semaphore.release()

        task.add_done_callback(_done)
        return True

    async def _execute(self, context: JobContext) -> None:
        started = time.monotonic()
        beat = asyncio.create_task(self._heartbeat(context))
        try:
            handler = get_handler(context.kind)
            result = await handler(context)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except UnknownJobKindError as exc:
            await self._record_failure(context, exc, retry=False)
        except TransientJobError as exc:
            await self._record_failure(context, exc, retry=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Job %s (%s) failed", context.job_id, context.kind)
            await self._record_failure(context, exc, retry=False)
        else:
            async with self._session_factory() as session:
                stored = await queue.complete(
                    session, context.job_id, context.attempt, result
                )
            if not stored:
                logger.info("Result of job %s discarded", context.job_id)
            logger.info(
                "Job %s (%s) finished in %.2f s",
                context.job_id,
                context.kind,
                time.monotonic() - started,
            )
        finally:
            beat.cancel()
            with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await beat

    """Authenticated page in the app shell.

        route=route,
        title=title,
        template=template,
        admin_only=admin_only,
        on_load=cast("Any", handlers),
    )

"""Async repositories of the offer workshop."""

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import JobEntity, WorkspaceEntity
from appkit_commons.database.base_repository import BaseRepository


class WorkspaceRepository(BaseRepository[WorkspaceEntity, AsyncSession]):
    """Reads and writes the workshop workspace of an offer."""

    @property
    def model_class(self) -> type[WorkspaceEntity]:
        return WorkspaceEntity

    async def find_by_offer(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int
    ) -> WorkspaceEntity | None:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(WorkspaceEntity).where(WorkspaceEntity.offer_id == offer_id)
        )


class JobRepository(BaseRepository[JobEntity, AsyncSession]):
    """Reads workshop jobs; writes go through ``workshop.jobs.queue``."""

    ) -> JobEntity | None:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(JobEntity)
            .where(JobEntity.offer_id == offer_id, JobEntity.kind == kind)

        )

"""Open the workshop workspace of an offer, creating it on first use."""

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import DocState, WorkspaceEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import (
    DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_KEY,
    load_template,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import workspace_repo


async def open_workspace(
    session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, user: str
) -> WorkspaceEntity:
    """The workspace of ``offer_id``; a new one is bound to the current template."""
    existing = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    template = load_template(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_KEY)
    workspace = WorkspaceEntity(
        offer_id=offer_id,
        template_key=template.key,
        template_version=template.version,
        vision="",
        roles=[],
        map_revision=0,
        story_seq=0,
        doc_state=DocState.DRAFT,
        auto_draft=False,
        created_by=user,
    )
    try:
        async with session.begin_nested():
            session.add(workspace)
    except IntegrityError:
        # A second tab created the workspace first.
        found = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        if found is None:
            raise
        return found
    return workspace

"""State of the offer workshop page."""

import logging
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from typing import Any

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.access import requires_offer_editor

from alloq_offer.repository import offer_repo
from alloq_offer.workshop.services.workspace import open_workspace
from appkit_commons.database.session import get_asyncdb_session
from appkit_user.authentication.states import UserSession

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

TAB_DRAFT = "draft"
TAB_CHAPTERS = "chapters"
TAB_BRIEFING = "briefing"
TAB_EXPORT = "export"
TABS: list[dict[str, str]] = [
    {"value": TAB_DRAFT, "label": "Entwurf & Story Map"},
    {"value": TAB_CHAPTERS, "label": "Kapitel"},
    {"value": TAB_BRIEFING, "label": "Briefing"},
    {"value": TAB_EXPORT, "label": "Export"},
]
NOT_FOUND = "Angebot nicht gefunden."
LOAD_ERROR = "Die Werkstatt konnte nicht geladen werden."
SAVE_ERROR = "Die Einstellung konnte nicht gespeichert werden."


class WorkshopState(rx.State):
    """Workspace of one offer and the active tab."""

    offer_id: rx.Field[int] = rx.field(0)
    offer_title: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    offer_customer: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    template_label: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    doc_state: rx.Field[str] = rx.field("")
    auto_draft: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    source_count: rx.Field[int] = rx.field(0)
    active_tab: rx.Field[str] = rx.field(TAB_DRAFT)
    loaded: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)
    not_found: rx.Field[bool] = rx.field(False)

    @rx.var
    def subtitle(self) -> str:
        if not self.loaded:
            return ""
        return f"{self.offer_customer} · Vorlage {self.template_label} · {self.doc_state}"

    @rx.var
    def can_generate(self) -> bool:
        return self.source_count > 0

    @rx.var
    def generate_label(self) -> str:
        return f"Entwurf aus {self.source_count} Quellen erzeugen"

    @rx.event
    def set_tab(self, tab: str) -> None:
        self.active_tab = tab

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def load_workshop(self) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Load the offer and create its workspace on first visit."""
        self.loaded = False
        self.not_found = False
        try:
            offer_id = int(self.router.page.params.get("offer_id", "0"))
        except ValueError:
            offer_id = 0
        try:
            async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
                offer = await offer_repo.find_by_id(session, offer_id)
                if offer is None:
                    self.not_found = True
                    return
                user = await self.get_state(UserSession)
                name = user.user.name if user.user else ""
                workspace = await open_workspace(session, offer_id, name or "")
                self.offer_id = offer.id
                self.offer_title = offer.title
                self.offer_customer = offer.customer
                self.template_label = workspace.template_key.replace("_", " ").upper()
                self.doc_state = workspace.doc_state
                self.auto_draft = workspace.auto_draft
                self.loaded = True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Loading workshop of offer %s failed", offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(LOAD_ERROR, position="top-right")

    @rx.event
    @requires_offer_editor
    async def set_auto_draft(self, value: bool) -> AsyncGenerator[Any]:
        """Store whether new usable sources start a draft automatically."""
        try:
            async with get_asyncdb_session() as session:
                workspace = await open_workspace(session, self.offer_id, "")
                workspace.auto_draft = value
            self.auto_draft = value
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Saving auto draft of offer %s failed", self.offer_id)
            yield rx.toast.error(SAVE_ERROR, position="top-right")

"""Shared fixtures for the workshop tests: in-memory SQLite with the workshop tables."""

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from decimal import Decimal

from alloq_offer.entities import IndustryEntity, OfferEntity
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine

from appkit_commons.database.entities import Base

import alloq_offer.workshop.entities  # noqa: F401  (registers the workshop tables)


class Database:
    """SQLite engine whose sessions commit on exit like appkit's session manager."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.engine = create_async_engine("sqlite+aiosqlite:///:memory:")
        self._maker = async_sessionmaker(self.engine, expire_on_commit=False)

    async def create(self) -> None:
        async with self.engine.begin() as conn:
            await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
        async with self.session() as session:
            session.add(IndustryEntity(id=1, name="Handel"))
            session.add(
                OfferEntity(
                    id=1,
                    title="Plattform",
                    customer="Muster AG",
                    person_days=Decimal(10),
                    risk_buffer_days=Decimal(1),
                    production_cost=Decimal(1000),
                    recommended_price=Decimal(2000),
                    key_accounter="Anna",
                    industry_id=1,
                    state="Neu",
                )
            )

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def session(self) -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
        async with self._maker() as session:
            try:
                yield session
                await session.commit()
            except Exception:
                await session.rollback()
                raise

    async def dispose(self) -> None:
        await self.engine.dispose()

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from alloq_offer.workshop.configuration import WorkshopConfig
from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import JobEntity, JobStatus
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs import queue

)
from alloq_offer.workshop.jobs.runner import JobRunner

NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 23, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


async def _enqueue(db, key: str = "k1", kind: str = "demo", **over) -> int:
    async with db.session() as session:
        job = await queue.enqueue(
            session, kind=kind, offer_id=1, idempotency_key=key, now=NOW, **over
        )
        await session.flush()
        return job.id


async def _job(db, job_id: int) -> JobEntity:
    async with db.session() as session:
        job = await session.get(JobEntity, job_id)
        assert job is not None
        return job


async def test_enqueue_is_idempotent(db) -> None:
    first = await _enqueue(db)
    second = await _enqueue(db)
    assert first == second


async def test_claim_leases_and_hides_job(db) -> None:
    job_id = await _enqueue(db)
    async with db.session() as session:
        claimed = await queue.claim_next(session, now=NOW, lease_seconds=60)
        assert claimed is not None
        assert (claimed.id, claimed.attempts) == (job_id, 1)
    async with db.session() as session:
        assert await queue.claim_next(session, now=NOW, lease_seconds=60) is None


async def test_claim_respects_run_after_and_kind_filter(db) -> None:
    await _enqueue(db, "a", "later")
    async with db.session() as session:
        assert (
            await queue.claim_next(
                session, now=NOW - timedelta(minutes=1), lease_seconds=60
            )
            is None
        )
        assert (
            await queue.claim_next(session, now=NOW, lease_seconds=60, kinds=["x"])
            is None
        )

    job_id = await _enqueue(db, max_attempts=2)
    async with db.session() as session:
        await queue.claim_next(session, now=NOW, lease_seconds=10)
    later = NOW + timedelta(seconds=11)
    async with db.session() as session:
        again = await queue.claim_next(session, now=later, lease_seconds=10)
        assert again is not None
        assert again.attempts == 2
    async with db.session() as session:
        gone = await queue.claim_next(

        )

    assert (await _job(db, job_id)).status == JobStatus.FAILED

  Efficiency review of the staged Phase 1 changes: 6 findings, all minor. Nothing blocks. I read every changed file in the workshop package, plus app/app.py and the config. I did not run anything.
  
  1. **jobs/runner.py:69-89 (`run_forever`) — idle polling.**
     - Each empty poll opens a session and runs one SELECT (`claim_next`) every 2 s, plus a transaction open and close. This repeats for every runner on the shared queue (server and desktop).
     - The query is an OR across the QUEUED and RUNNING branches. The only index is `(status, run_after)`, so the `RUNNING AND lease_until < now` branch has no index and reads every RUNNING row. That is fine at this scale.
     - Cheaper: use exponential idle backoff (2 s, 4 s, up to 15-30 s, reset on a hit), or on Postgres wake with `LISTEN/NOTIFY` and keep a slow poll only for lease expiry.
     - Also split the lease scan into a second query that runs only every Nth idle tick, or add a partial index on `lease_until WHERE status='running'`.
  
  2. **jobs/queue.py:186-190 (`_owned`) via 118-131 (`heartbeat`), 134-144 (`complete`) and 147-169 (`fail`) — two round trips per call.**
     - `session.get` does a SELECT, then the flush does an UPDATE. A heartbeat runs every `lease_seconds/3` (100 s) per running job, with a fresh session each time.
     - Cheaper: one conditional statement, `UPDATE offer_jobs SET lease_until=... WHERE id=:id AND status='running' AND attempts=:attempt`, and use `rowcount == 1` as "owned". `complete` and `fail` can do the same. `fail` needs `attempts < max_attempts` in a CASE, or a RETURNING.
  
  3. **jobs/queue.py:35-37 (`enqueue`) — SELECT before INSERT.**
     - The idempotency-key SELECT runs on every call, even though the savepoint and `IntegrityError` path already handles the race.
     - Cheaper: `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING`, then a SELECT only when nothing was returned. Optional, because enqueue is not a hot path.
  
  4. **jobs/runner.py:61-67 and 95-97 (`_execute`) — heartbeat task per job.**
     - Every job starts a separate heartbeat task, and each beat opens its own session. With concurrency 2 this is negligible.
     - Cheaper if concurrency grows: one heartbeat loop per runner that extends all of its running job ids in a single `UPDATE ... WHERE id = ANY(:ids)`.
  
  5. **states/workshop_state.py:74-99 (`load_workshop`) and 101-112 (`set_auto_draft`) — redundant reads.**
     - `load_workshop` does `offer_repo.find_by_id`, then `get_state(LoginState)` plus `await login.authenticated_user`, then `open_workspace` (another SELECT). That is two queries and a user resolution run in sequence. The user lookup is only needed on first creation.
     - Cheaper: resolve the user name lazily inside `open_workspace` (pass a callable), or run the offer lookup and the workspace lookup concurrently. They are independent, so `asyncio.gather` on two sessions works.
     - `set_auto_draft` calls `open_workspace` (SELECT, with a possible create) and then updates. It could be `UPDATE offer_workspaces SET auto_draft=:v WHERE offer_id=:id`. The state field `source_count` also looks unused so far.
  
  6. **export/template_package.py:78-94 (`load_template`) and 61-68 (`check_layout`) — blocking work on the event loop.**
     - The first call per process reads two YAML files and the docx, then fully parses the docx with python-docx (`check_layout`). It is `@cache`d, so this happens once. The first call runs synchronously inside the async handler `open_workspace` (services/workspace.py:21, first workspace creation) and later inside the worker.
     - The same layout bytes are parsed again for every render (`DocxTemplate(io.BytesIO(...))` in export/docx_renderer.py:33) and by `find_anchor`. The render parse is unavoidable, but `check_layout` could be skipped on the request path.
     - Cheaper: warm the cache at startup, for example inside `offer_workshop_worker` via `asyncio.to_thread(load_template)`. Or wrap `load_template` with `to_thread` where it is called from async code.
  
  Checked and clean:
  - app/app.py:95: `register_lifespan_task` does no work at import time. The worker does not poll when `worker_enabled` is false (the default), so startup is not blocked.

content.text:
Phase 0 und Phase 1 sind gebaut, mit `/simplify` und `/code-review` geprüft und gestaged. Es ist noch nichts committet. Die komplette Testsuite läuft grün (1683 Tests), Ruff ist sauber, und `ty` meldet in den neuen Dateien keine Fehler.

**Phase 0: Vorlage und Inhaltsmodell**
- **Vorlage:** `layout.docx` entsteht per Skript aus dem QUO-Dokument. Es enthält Titelseite mit Platzhaltern, Inhaltsverzeichnis, einen Anker `[[KAPITEL]]` und die festen Rechtsteile. Kundendaten sind entfernt.
- **Kapitel und Inhaltsmodell:**
  - `chapters.yaml` und `rules.yaml` im Vorlagenpaket.
  - Vier Kapiteltypen: `prose`, `table`, `stories`, `calc`. Unzulässiger Inhalt wird mit deutscher Fehlermeldung abgelehnt.
- **Word-Renderer:** pro Kapiteltyp ein Renderer. `stories` zeigt die geschriebenen Stories, die Story Map kommt nie ins Dokument.
- **Dokumentation:** Das Inventar steht in `docs/features/offer-workshop-template.md`, ein Beispiel-Export in `docs/features/offer-workshop-sample.docx`.

**Phase 1: Fundament**
- **Migration:** `b3c4d5e6f7a8` mit den Tabellen `offer_workspaces`, `offer_blobs` und `offer_jobs`. Sie steht in `KNOWN_REVISIONS` und in `alembic/env.py`; ich habe sie nicht ausgeführt.
- **Job-Queue und Worker:**
  - Persistente Queue mit Lease und Wiederholungen mit Backoff.
  - Der Worker läuft über `app.register_lifespan_task` und ist per `app.offer_workshop.worker_enabled` schaltbar (standardmäßig aus).
  - Ein Runner nimmt nur Jobs, für die er einen Handler kennt.
- **Seite und Einstieg:**
  - Neue Seite `/offers/[offer_id]/werkstatt` mit den vier Tabs und der Startkarte.
  - Der Offer-Inspector hat den Button „Werkstatt öffnen“.

**Offen und nicht geprüft**
- Nicht im Browser angeschaut: Die Seite wird nur durch Tests abgedeckt, ein Preview-Lauf würde die geteilte Remote-DB brauchen.
- **Gate vor Phase 3:** Bitte öffne `docs/features/offer-workshop-sample.docx` in Word und bestätige das Layout. Phase 2 braucht das Gate nicht.
- In der Review bewusst nicht umgesetzt: Heartbeat, Abschluss und Fehlermeldung eines Jobs brauchen je zwei Datenbankzugriffe. Außerdem stehen Stilnamen und Tabellen-XML noch im Renderer statt im Vorlagenpaket.

Soll ich Phase 0 und 1 getrennt committen und mit Phase 2 weitermachen?

Auf der Werkstatt-Seite war aber nirgends ein Eintrag markiert, weil die Sidebar nur exakte Pfade erkennt. Ich habe das in `app/components/sidebar.py` geändert: „Angebote“ bleibt jetzt markiert, solange der Pfad mit `/offers/` beginnt. Dazu gibt es einen Test in `tests/test_sidebar.py`, der Sidebar-Test läuft grün. Im Browser habe ich es nicht angeschaut.

Falls du einen eigenen Menüpunkt meinst (zum Beispiel „Werkstatt“, der zur zuletzt geöffneten oder zu einer Angebotsauswahl führt), sag mir, wie er sich verhalten soll.

    @field_validator("sharepoint_url")

TEXT_FIELDS: Final = ("title", "customer", "key_accounter", "sharepoint_url")

    "person_days",

)

def _today() -> date:
    return datetime.now(tz=UTC).date()


def _empty_form() -> dict[str, str]:
    form = dict.fromkeys(FORM_FIELDS, "")
    form["risk_buffer_days"] = "0"
    form["state"] = OfferStateEnum.NEW.value
    return form


def _form_from(offer: Offer) -> dict[str, str]:
    form = _empty_form()
    for field in (*TEXT_FIELDS, "industry_id", "state"):
        form[field] = str(getattr(offer, field) or "")
    for field in NUMBER_FIELDS:
        form[field] = str(getattr(offer, field))
    form["sent_date"] = offer.sent_date.isoformat() if offer.sent_date else ""
    return form


def number_text(value: Any) -> str:
    """Normalize a number input value (float or German text) to "1234.5"."""
    if value is None:
        return ""
    text = str(value).replace("€", "").replace(" ", "").strip()

def _text(name: str, label: str, *, required: bool = True, limit: int = 255, **kw):  # noqa: ANN003, ANN202

        ),
        section(

                required=False,
                limit=2048,


PROJECT_DURATION_DAYS: Final = 90


def can_accept(offer: Offer) -> bool:
    """Only archived-free offers without a project can be accepted."""
    return not offer.archived and offer.project_id is None


def default_project_dates(today: date) -> tuple[date, date]:
    """Suggested start and end of the project of an accepted offer."""
    return today, today + timedelta(days=PROJECT_DURATION_DAYS)


def project_from_offer(
    offer: Offer, code: str, start_date: date, end_date: date
) -> ProjectEntity:
    """Planned project with the title, customer and price of ``offer``."""
    return ProjectEntity(
        code=code,
        customer=offer.customer,
        name_de=offer.title,
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        state=ProjectStateEnum.PLANNED,
        budget=int(offer.recommended_price.to_integral_value()),
    )


def total_days(offer: Offer) -> Decimal:
    """Person days plus risk buffer."""
    return offer.person_days + offer.risk_buffer_days


def margin_pct(offer: Offer) -> Decimal | None:
    """Margin in percent of the recommended price; None when it is 0."""
    if not offer.recommended_price:
        return None
    return (
        (offer.recommended_price - offer.production_cost)
        / offer.recommended_price
        * 100
    )

}


def state_badge(state: rx.Var[str]) -> rx.Component:
    tone = rx.match(state, *STATE_TONES.items(), "neutral")
    return badge(state, tone)


def euro(value: rx.Var) -> rx.Component:
    return de_number(value=value.to(float), decimal_scale=2, suffix=" €")


def days(value: rx.Var) -> rx.Component:
    return de_number(
        value=value.to(float),
        decimal_scale=2,
        minimum_fraction_digits=0,
        suffix=" PT",
    )


def date_or_dash(value: rx.Var) -> rx.Var:
    """DD.MM.YYYY from an ISO date string, "–" when empty."""
    return rx.cond(value, format_date_de(value), "–")

## OFF-04 Create an offer {#off-04}

Enter a new offer with its numbers, customer data and status.

As an offer editor, I want to enter a new offer with person days, buffer, cost and price, so that the team keeps all offers in one place.

Offer editor · Create an offer / Enter the offer · priority 1 · core · unreleased

### Acceptance criteria

1. **Given** the button "Angebot anlegen" [create offer], **when** the user clicks it, **then** the empty dialog "Neues Angebot" [new offer] opens with "Risikopuffer (Personentage)" set to 0 and "Status" set to "Neu". Reopening the dialog clears the inputs again.
2. **Given** the dialog, **when** it renders, **then** it has the fields "Angebotstitel" [offer title], "Kunde" [customer], "Account Manager", "Branche" [industry], "Kalkulierte Personentage" [calculated person days], "Risikopuffer (Personentage)", "Kosten" [cost], "Empfohlener Preis" [recommended price], "Status", "Versendet am" and "Link zu den Dokumenten" [link to the documents]. "Branche" lists the industries from [OFF-09](#off-09) by name.

async def map_edit(
    session_factory: SessionFactory, offer_id: int, expected_revision: int
) -> AsyncIterator[tuple[AsyncSession, WorkspaceEntity]]:
    """A transaction on the locked workspace; a stale ``expected_revision`` fails."""
    async with session_factory() as session:
        workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        if workspace is None:
            raise MapEditError(NOT_FOUND)
        await session.refresh(workspace, with_for_update=True)
        if workspace.map_revision != expected_revision:
            raise MapConflictError(CONFLICT)
        yield session, workspace

    """Bump the revision and keep an immutable snapshot of the result."""

        MapRevisionEntity(
            offer_id=workspace.offer_id,
            revision=workspace.map_revision,
            snapshot=await snapshot_map(session, workspace),
            created_by=user,
        )
    )
    return workspace.map_revision

"""Async repositories of the offer workshop."""

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import (
    JobEntity,
    SourceBlockEntity,
    SourceEntity,
    WorkspaceEntity,
)
from appkit_commons.database.base_repository import BaseRepository


class WorkspaceRepository(BaseRepository[WorkspaceEntity, AsyncSession]):
    """Reads and writes the workshop workspace of an offer."""

    @property
    def model_class(self) -> type[WorkspaceEntity]:
        return WorkspaceEntity

    async def find_by_offer(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int
    ) -> WorkspaceEntity | None:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(WorkspaceEntity).where(WorkspaceEntity.offer_id == offer_id)
        )


class JobRepository(BaseRepository[JobEntity, AsyncSession]):
    """Reads workshop jobs; writes go through ``workshop.jobs.queue``."""

    @property
    def model_class(self) -> type[JobEntity]:
        return JobEntity

    async def count_of_kind(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, kind: str
    ) -> int:
        return (
            await session.scalar(
                select(func.count())
                .select_from(JobEntity)
                .where(JobEntity.offer_id == offer_id, JobEntity.kind == kind)
            )
            or 0
        )

    async def find_latest(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, kind: str
    ) -> JobEntity | None:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(JobEntity)
            .where(JobEntity.offer_id == offer_id, JobEntity.kind == kind)
            .order_by(JobEntity.id.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )


class SourceRepository(BaseRepository[SourceEntity, AsyncSession]):
    """Reads the customer sources of an offer; revoked sources never show up."""

    @property
    def model_class(self) -> type[SourceEntity]:
        return SourceEntity

    async def find_in_offer(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, source_id: int
    ) -> SourceEntity | None:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(SourceEntity).where(
                SourceEntity.id == source_id, SourceEntity.offer_id == offer_id
            )
        )

    async def find_by_sha(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, sha256: str
    ) -> SourceEntity | None:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(SourceEntity)
            .where(
                SourceEntity.offer_id == offer_id,
                SourceEntity.sha256 == sha256,
                SourceEntity.revoked_at.is_(None),
            )
            .order_by(SourceEntity.id.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )

    async def find_latest_by_filename(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, filename: str
    ) -> SourceEntity | None:
        return await session.scalar(
            select(SourceEntity)
            .where(
                SourceEntity.offer_id == offer_id,
                SourceEntity.filename == filename,
                SourceEntity.revoked_at.is_(None),
            )
            .order_by(SourceEntity.version.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )

    async def list_current(
        self, session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int
    ) -> list[SourceEntity]:
        """Sources that are neither revoked nor replaced by a newer version."""
        rows = (
            await session.scalars(
                select(SourceEntity)
                .where(
                    SourceEntity.offer_id == offer_id,
                    SourceEntity.revoked_at.is_(None),
                )
                .order_by(SourceEntity.id)
            )
        ).all()
        replaced = {row.replaces_id for row in rows if row.replaces_id is not None}
        return [row for row in rows if row.id not in replaced]


class SourceBlockRepository(BaseRepository[SourceBlockEntity, AsyncSession]):
    """Reads and replaces the extracted blocks of a source."""

    @property
    def model_class(self) -> type[SourceBlockEntity]:
        return SourceBlockEntity

    async def list_for_source(
        self, session: AsyncSession, source_id: int
    ) -> list[SourceBlockEntity]:
        return list(
            (
                await session.scalars(

@cache
def load_prompt(name: str) -> str:
    return (
        resources.files("alloq_offer.workshop.ai.prompts")
        .joinpath(f"{name}.md")
        .read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    )


def build_azure_model(config: WorkshopConfig) -> Model:
    azure = config.azure_openai
    if not (azure.endpoint and azure.chat_deployment):
        raise AiUnavailableError(NOT_CONFIGURED)
    provider = AzureProvider(
        azure_endpoint=azure.endpoint,
        api_version=azure.api_version,
        api_key=REDACTED,
    )
    return OpenAIChatModel(azure.chat_deployment, provider=provider)


class PydanticOfferAi:
    """Proposals from a pydantic-ai model; outputs are validated or retried."""

    map_prompt_version = MAP_PROMPT
    briefing_prompt_version = BRIEFING_PROMPT

    def __init__(self, model: Model, config: WorkshopConfig, name: str) -> None:
        self._model = model
        self._config = config
        self.model_name = name

    async def _run[T](
        self, output: type[T], prompt: str, user_prompt: str, label: str
    ) -> T:
        agent = Agent(
            self._model,
            name=label,
            output_type=output,
            instructions=load_prompt(prompt),
            retries=2,
            model_settings=ModelSettings(timeout=self._config.ai_timeout_seconds),
        )
        try:
            result = await agent.run(
                user_prompt,
                usage_limits=UsageLimits(request_limit=self._config.ai_request_limit),
            )
        except ModelHTTPError as exc:
            if exc.status_code == RATE_LIMITED or exc.status_code >= SERVER_ERROR:
                raise AiTransientError(label) from exc
            raise AiUnavailableError(label) from exc
        except (httpx.TransportError, TimeoutError) as exc:
            raise AiTransientError(label) from exc
        except UnexpectedModelBehavior as exc:
            raise AiUnavailableError(label) from exc
        logger.info("Model run %s used %s", label, result.usage)
        return result.output

    async def propose_map(self, sources: list[SourceText]) -> ProposedMap:
        data = render_sources(sources, self._config.ai_max_input_chars)
        return await self._run(ProposedMap, MAP_PROMPT, data, "propose_map")

    async def propose_briefing(self, sources: list[SourceText]) -> ProposedBriefing:
        data = render_sources(sources, self._config.ai_max_input_chars)
        return await self._run(
            ProposedBriefing, BRIEFING_PROMPT, data, "propose_briefing"
        )


def create_offer_ai(config: WorkshopConfig) -> PydanticOfferAi:
    return PydanticOfferAi(
        build_azure_model(config), config, config.azure_openai.chat_deployment
    )

TRUNCATED = "[Weitere Quellen wurden wegen der Länge ausgelassen.]"


def _escape(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("</quelle>", "<\\/quelle>").replace("<quelle", "<\\quelle")


def render_sources(sources: list[SourceText], max_chars: int) -> str:
    """One ``<quelle>`` block per source; whole sources are dropped past the budget."""
    parts: list[str] = []
    used = 0
    for source in sources:
        lines = [f'<quelle id="{source.id}" art="{_escape(source.kind)}">']
        lines.append(f"Titel: {_escape(source.title)}")
        for block in source.blocks:
            speaker = f"{block.speaker}: " if block.speaker else ""
            label = f" ({block.label})" if block.label else ""
            lines.append(f"[B{block.id}]{label} {speaker}{_escape(block.text)}")
        lines.extend(f"[Lücke] {_escape(gap)}" for gap in source.gaps)
        lines.append("</quelle>")
        text = "\n".join(lines)
        if parts and used + len(text) > max_chars:
            parts.append(TRUNCATED)
            break
        parts.append(text)
        used += len(text)
    return "\n\n".join(parts)

KIND_NAMES = {
    SourceKind.EML: "E-Mail",
    SourceKind.AUDIO: "Mitschnitt",

}


class InitialDraft:
    """Builds the first map; an existing map is never touched by the model."""

    def __init__(self, ai: OfferAi, session_factory: SessionFactory) -> None:
        self._ai = ai
        self._session_factory = session_factory

    async def run(self, ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
        loaded = await self._load(ctx.offer_id)
        if loaded is None:
            return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "map exists or no sources"}
        sources, valid_ids = loaded
        try:
            proposed, briefing = await asyncio.gather(
                self._ai.propose_map(sources), self._ai.propose_briefing(sources)
            )
        except AiTransientError as exc:
            await self._record_run(ctx, sources, "wiederholt")
            raise TransientJobError(AI_BUSY) from exc
        except AiUnavailableError as exc:
            await self._record_run(ctx, sources, "fehlgeschlagen")
            raise PermanentJobError(AI_FAILED) from exc
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            workspace = await open_workspace(session, ctx.offer_id, "")
            # Lock the row: a second run must wait and then see the new map.
            await session.refresh(workspace, with_for_update=True)
            if workspace.map_revision > 0:
                return {"status": "skipped", "reason": "map exists"}
            applied = await apply_proposed_map(session, workspace, proposed, valid_ids)
            statements = await apply_briefing(
                session, ctx.offer_id, briefing, valid_ids
            )
            self._add_run(session, ctx, sources, "ok")
        logger.info(
            "Initial draft of offer %s: %d stories, %d skipped",
            ctx.offer_id,
            applied.stories,
            len(applied.skipped),
        )
        return {
            "status": "ok",
            "stories": applied.stories,
            "skipped": len(applied.skipped),
            "statements": applied.statements + statements,
        }

    def _add_run(
        self,
        session: AsyncSession,
        ctx: JobContext,
        sources: list[SourceText],
        status: str,
    ) -> None:
        session.add(
            GenerationRunEntity(
                offer_id=ctx.offer_id,
                job_id=ctx.job_id,
                kind=INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB,
                model=self._ai.model_name,
                prompt_version=(
                    f"{self._ai.map_prompt_version}+{self._ai.briefing_prompt_version}"
                ),
                input_revisions={"sources": [source.id for source in sources]},
                status=status,
            )
        )

    async def _record_run(
        self, ctx: JobContext, sources: list[SourceText], status: str
    ) -> None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            self._add_run(session, ctx, sources, status)

    async def _load(self, offer_id: int) -> tuple[list[SourceText], set[int]] | None:
        async with self._session_factory() as session:
            workspace = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
            if workspace is not None and workspace.map_revision > 0:
                return None
            sources: list[SourceText] = []
            valid_ids: set[int] = set()
            for source in await source_repo.list_current(session, offer_id):
                if not source.included or source.status not in READABLE_STATUSES:
                    continue
                blocks = await source_block_repo.list_for_source(session, source.id)
                texts = [
                    BlockText(b.id, b.text, anchor_label(b.anchor), b.speaker)
                    for b in blocks
                    if b.kind != KIND_GAP
                ]
                valid_ids.update(block.id for block in texts)
                sources.append(
                    SourceText(
                        id=source.id,
                        title=source.title,
                        kind=KIND_NAMES.get(SourceKind(source.kind), "Dokument"),
                        blocks=texts,
                        gaps=[b.text for b in blocks if b.kind == KIND_GAP],
                    )
                )
        return (sources, valid_ids) if sources else None


@register_handler(INITIAL_DRAFT_JOB)
async def initial_draft(ctx: JobContext) -> dict:
    config = service_registry().get(WorkshopConfig)
    return await InitialDraft(create_offer_ai(config), get_asyncdb_session).run(ctx)

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import select

from alloq_offer.workshop.db import SessionFactory

    SourceBlockEntity,

    StatementStatus,

)
from alloq_offer.workshop.extraction.models import anchor_label

TYPE_ORDER = [
    StatementType.REQUIREMENT,
    StatementType.FACT,
    StatementType.SOLUTION,
    StatementType.ASSUMPTION,
    StatementType.OPEN_POINT,
    StatementType.CONFLICT,
]


async def _ref_labels(session: AsyncSession, block_ids: set[int]) -> dict[int, str]:
    if not block_ids:
        return {}
    rows = await session.execute(
        select(SourceBlockEntity.id, SourceBlockEntity.anchor, SourceEntity.title)
        .join(SourceEntity, SourceEntity.id == SourceBlockEntity.source_id)
        .where(SourceBlockEntity.id.in_(block_ids), SourceEntity.revoked_at.is_(None))
    )
    return {
        block_id: ", ".join(filter(None, [title, anchor_label(anchor)]))
        for block_id, anchor, title in rows.all()
    }


async def load_briefing(session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Statement groups in the order of ``TYPE_ORDER``; empty groups are left out."""
    statements = list(
        (
            await session.scalars(
                select(StatementEntity)
                .where(StatementEntity.offer_id == offer_id)
                .order_by(StatementEntity.id)
            )
        ).all()
    )
    labels = await _ref_labels(
        session, {ref for s in statements for ref in s.source_refs}
    )
    groups: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for type_ in TYPE_ORDER:
        items = [
            {
                "id": s.id,
                "text": s.text,
                "confirmed": s.status == StatementStatus.CONFIRMED,
                "recheck": s.needs_recheck,
                "confirmed_by": s.confirmed_by or "",
                "refs": [labels[r] for r in s.source_refs if r in labels],
            }
            for s in statements
            if s.type == type_
        ]
        if items:
            groups.append({"type": type_.value, "items": items})
    return groups


async def set_confirmed(
    session_factory: SessionFactory,
    offer_id: int,
    statement_id: int,
    *,
    confirmed: bool,
    user: str,
    now: datetime,
) -> bool:
    """Confirm a statement as a professional decision, or take that back.

    Only this explicit action changes the status; drafting never confirms (A17).
    """
    async with session_factory() as session:
        statement = await session.get(StatementEntity, statement_id)
        if statement is None or statement.offer_id != offer_id:
            return False
        statement.status = (
            StatementStatus.CONFIRMED if confirmed else StatementStatus.PROPOSED
        )
        statement.confirmed_by = user if confirmed else None
        statement.confirmed_at = now if confirmed else None
        if confirmed:
            statement.needs_recheck = False
        return True

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from alloq_offer.workshop.entities import WorkspaceEntity
from alloq_offer.workshop.export.template_package import (
    DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_KEY,
    load_template,
)
from alloq_offer.workshop.repositories import workspace_repo


async def open_workspace(
    session: AsyncSession, offer_id: int, user: str
) -> WorkspaceEntity:
    """The workspace of ``offer_id``; a new one is bound to the current template."""
    existing = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    template = load_template(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_KEY)
    workspace = WorkspaceEntity(
        offer_id=offer_id,
        template_key=template.key,
        template_version=template.version,
        created_by=user,
    )
    try:
        async with session.begin_nested():
            session.add(workspace)
    except IntegrityError:
        # A second tab created the workspace first.
        found = await workspace_repo.find_by_offer(session, offer_id)
        if found is None:
            raise
        return found
    return workspace
"""The story map as a grid of plain values for the page (from a map snapshot)."""

from typing import Any

NO_SLICE_ID = 0
NO_SLICE_TITLE = "Ohne Umsetzungsschnitt"
ORIGIN_SOURCE = "Quellenstellen"


def _card(story: dict, task_title: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    refs = len(story["source_refs"])
    return {
        "id": story["id"],
        "key": story["key"],
        "title": story["title"],
        "meta": f"{task_title} · {story['scope']} · {story['origin']}",
        "scope": story["scope"],
        "skeleton": story["skeleton"],
        "origin": story["origin"],
        "sentence": story["sentence"],
        "refs": f"{refs} {ORIGIN_SOURCE}" if refs else "ohne Quellenbezug",
    }


def build_view(snapshot: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Columns, slice rows, option lists and a story lookup for the editor."""
    activities = [a for a in snapshot["activities"] if not a["archived"]]
    slices = snapshot["slices"]
    tasks_of = {
        a["id"]: [t for t in a["tasks"] if not t["archived"]] for a in activities
    }
    columns = [
        {
            "id": a["id"],
            "title": a["title"],
            "tasks": " · ".join(t["title"] for t in tasks_of[a["id"]]),
            "task_id": tasks_of[a["id"]][0]["id"] if tasks_of[a["id"]] else 0,
            "first": index == 0,
            "last": index == len(activities) - 1,
        }
        for index, a in enumerate(activities)
    ]

    def cell(activity: dict, slice_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        stories = [
            _card(s, t["title"])
            for t in tasks_of[activity["id"]]
            for s in t["stories"]
            if not s["archived"] and (s["slice_id"] or NO_SLICE_ID) == slice_id
        ]
        first_task = (
            tasks_of[activity["id"]][0]["id"] if tasks_of[activity["id"]] else 0
        )
        return {
            "activity_id": activity["id"],
            "task_id": first_task,
            "stories": stories,
        }

    row_defs = [(s["id"], s["title"], True) for s in slices] + [
        (NO_SLICE_ID, NO_SLICE_TITLE, False)
    ]
    rows = [
        {
            "slice_id": slice_id,
            "title": title,
            "editable": editable,
            "cells": [cell(a, slice_id) for a in activities],
        }
        for slice_id, title, editable in row_defs
    ]
    lookup = {
        str(story["id"]): {
            **_card(story, task["title"]),
            "role": story["role"],
            "goal": story["goal"],
            "benefit": story["benefit"],
            "task_id": str(task["id"]),
            "slice_id": str(story["slice_id"] or NO_SLICE_ID),
        }
        for activity in activities
        for task in tasks_of[activity["id"]]
        for story in task["stories"]
        if not story["archived"]
    }
    return {
        "columns": columns,
        "rows": rows,
        "stories": lookup,
        "story_count": len(lookup),
        "task_options": [
            {"value": str(t["id"]), "label": f"{a['title']} · {t['title']}"}
            for a in activities
            for t in tasks_of[a["id"]]
        ],
        "slice_options": [{"value": str(NO_SLICE_ID), "label": NO_SLICE_TITLE}]
        + [{"value": str(s["id"]), "label": s["title"]} for s in slices],
    }
                ],
            }
            for a in activities
        ],
        "unassigned": [_story_dict(s) for s in stories if s.task_id is None],
    }
